Rulebook v2.1.0 (2026-07-10)

Changes in v2.1.0:
* Returning from or losing a travel adventure no longer costs XP.
  (The destination still becomes RISKY: +5 tiles to reach it.)
* Mid-campaign recruits cost the party 1 LORE + 10 XP and never claim
  FOUNDER unless the party has none.
* Editorial: typos and encoding artifacts fixed, unreadable tables
  re-typeset, stale page references replaced with section names.

CORE RULES
                          CONVENTIONS AND THE TAG SYSTEM
                    Easy Dungeon Delver Sandbox (EDDS) presents board game
   rules for the 5e style fantasy RPGs. Ready your d20 dice, pen and paper!
  Use D20 Map to roll dice other than d20. D20 Name means rolling d20 to pick an entry from the table in respective section. N+ means N or more.
`DifficultyType SkillName to X` - Task with one of the D20 Skills, where success allows you do X. E.g. "REAL to find pawn shop" - medium difficulty on random D20 Skill, passing which gets hero to a pawn shop. Or `HARD Survival to cross desert` - this one has specific skill - Survival. 
When instructed to `gain TAG`, write TAG into the party sheet. Party - all heroes. But if it says `HERO gains TAG`, the tag goes into that hero's sheet.
We check presence of these tags on the party by the `If TAG` conditions. And on a hero by `If HERO has TAG`. "Tag" is the same as "token".
When instructed to `lose TAG`, cross out a single TAG from the sheet, proceeding as if the party no longer has it. Several same name tags allowed: E.g. multiple MONTH/FULFILED/INFAMY/RATION tags.
If tag adds/suppresses a tag temporarily, the suppression beats addition. 
Disadvantage: roll twice - pick worst. Advantage: roll twice - pick best.
STARTING THE CAMPAIGN
Gain NORMAL (or see DIFFICULTY OPTIONS).
Each player generates a hero (see HERO GENERATION).
Each hero rolls d20: the one with the highest roll gains FOUNDER, who acts first in the turn order. Heroes start at a random Area (see below).
Finally each hero rolls D20 Bond, determining their origin and motive.
You're officially in the world of Nymara! 
AREA of world map has D6 Ways to other areas + the way used to enter it.
D6 WAYS:  1. N+SW;   2. S+NE;   3. W+SE;   4. E+NW.   5. Dungeon.
                 6. Continues in the direction it was explored from
      If SW/NE/SE/NW in a new area leads to area accessible in other way,
      discard this way from the new tile, while N/E/S/W gets connected.
Area has Remoteness (starting area has 0), and new area has Remoteness of
 the area it was first traveled from plus 1.
Area has a biome. If N/E/S/W way is explored and
non-city, inherit its biome, otherwise roll D20 Biome:
1-3. Plains.   4-5. Hills. Only INFORMED can enter
6-8. City (or Sea if adjacent to other city).
        City has biome of the area it explored from.
        Roll d20 for city size: 1-10. SMALL; 11-17. MEDIUM. 18-20. LARGE.
9-10. Forest. Only INFORMED can enter
11-12. Swamp if explored from Plains/Sea/Forest; else - Desert.
            Only PREPARED can enter
13-14. Mountain. Only PREPARED can enter.
15-20. If adjacent to a city then Sea and needs SHIP to enter.
            Else inherits biome of the adjacent explored area.
If no City exists anywhere when an area of Remoteness 2 is generated,
   that area is a City instead (roll its size normally). This keeps the
   first city - where trade, quests and services live - within reach.
Areas NW and NE from any mountain are Frozen: need PREPARED to enter.
No unexplored ways? - Most north-west area has unexplored D6 Ways.
Unexplored area north of any mountain always leads to Netherelm.
Unexplored SW/SE areas from Netherelm always lead to Umbrath.
To TRAVEL to adjacent target Area do the WILDS or CITY ADVENTURE section.
If daily chase enemies reached you, they spawn on the Start Tile.
Once you've explored the current area Remoteness number of tiles, spend RATION while having INFORMED/PREPARED/SHIP (if the target biome needs them), you enter the target area, and the day ends. If lose adventure or return, the day ends too.
The target area biome gets known only after exploring the Remoteness tiles.
By spending 1xp, heroes can leave travel adventure the way they came.
RISKY AREA (bad weather, bandits, etc...)
If you return from or lose the travel adventure, the destination area
becomes RISKY: you must explore +5 more tiles to reach it. Returning or
losing costs no XP. Only one area is RISKY at a time - it stays RISKY
until another non-adjacent area becomes RISKY.
PREPARE: spend 10 XP to gain PREPARED, but lose all items/gp.
D20 DUNGEON: resides at the next explored mountain. follow Adventure rules, but spawn monsters from D12 Dwellers, and BOSS is a D20 Boss.
Once the BOSS is defeated, get D20 Legendary Item.

D6 BIOME: 1. Plains,  2. Forest,   3. Mountains,
                    4. Desert, 5. Frozen,  6. Netherelm
                             ADVENTURE
          When heroes enter a location at the world map area, roll
          D20 Tile to place the Start Tile. Spawn heroes there.
   The Start Tile doesn't grant XP, but heroes can leave adventure from it.
   Tile is a place/room, containing characters and props.
SEQUENCE OF PLAY
Heroes take turns clockwise starting with the FOUNDER.
Each hero turn consists of Hero Phase followed by the Enemy Phase.
A turn is all phases combined: hero phase, AI phase, etc..,
A round is all heroes turns combined. `Actor` is a hero, a foe or an NPC.
1. Hero Phase. Hero can either act (use power) or move to adjacent tile.
    Single bonus actions (e.g throwing an item) is free.
    To attack roll D20 Attack and, if hit, give target HURT tags:
      HIT STRENGTH |  FRAIL TARGET | NORMAL TARGET | TOUGH TARGET
      MEEK         |  none         | none          | none
      PUNY         |  2x HURT      | 1x HURT       | 1x HURT
      NORMAL       |  3x HURT      | 2x HURT       | 1x HURT
      STRONG       |  4x HURT      | 3x HURT       | 2x HURT
   Powers can override actor's natural strength (puny, strong, default).
   Actor HURT above 3 (6 if EPIC) gains COMA instead of more HURT.
   COMA hero can't act, but spend 2XP + 1 SURGE to discard 2 HURT and
   COMA. Actor leaving tile suffers default strength attack from its foes.
2. Exploration Phase. Instead of acting, hero can explore 1 adjacent tile:
    * Roll D20 Tile and draw it on your map, moving the hero to this tile.
    * Assigning AI of spawned monster to this hero.
    * On monster spawn, heroes gain its CR amount of XP.
       XP models dungeon knowledge, and CR stands for Challenge Rating.
    * A hero with ranged powers ([R] in name) can use 1 ranged power now.
3. Pick Formation: front-row or in the back-row. Non-PHASED Front-row
     heroes shield back-row from enemy's melee D20 Attack.
     Frontrow [R] attack has disadvantage outside of exploration phase.
4. AI Phase. Hero's player performs AI of the foes assigned on exploration.
    Foe without a hero on its tile will pursue the hero controlling it's AI.
    Heroes can do Chase to unassign foes (idle till another hero enters tile). 
LOSING ADVENTURE
If all heroes have COMA, they lose the adventure:
  * Heroes gain 1 SURGE, while each hero loses COMA and 2 HURT
  * If INFORMED, lose informed, else lose RATION (no ration - lose 1/2 gp).
            * If PRACTICE, gain 3 SURGEs, else gain RECKLESS.
D20 ATTACK
1. Miss and actor gains Disadvantage.
2. Hit if non-HARD/ABSURD and actor agrees to gain HURT,
    The AI of XP1 and XP2 monsters must agree.
3. Hit SLOW, HURT, EASY or ILL target
4. Hit unless AGILE target.
5. Hit if actor AGILE or EASY target.
6. Hit if ally is front-row on this tile.
7-8. Hit unless THICK (e.g. hide armor).
9. Hit unless HARD, ABSURD or THICK target.
10-11. Hit unless target INFORMED.
12-14. Hit if actor INFORMED
15-16. Hit unless target FULFILED or spends 2 XP.
17-18. Hit unless target spends 2 XP (e.g. take cover).
19. Hit unless SLOW actor or SMALL, HARD or ABSURD target.
20. Hit non-ABSURD target, which, unless actor SLOW, gains Disadvantage.
21-30. Hit if actor FULFILED or target has 2 HURT.
Notes: * CR N monsters can spend up to N XP to modify it's roll.
* To-Hit (default 1) - XP amount actor can spend to modify their roll.
* AC (default 1) - XP amount target can spend to modify actor's roll.
* Actor spends first. WISE monster spawns with XP equivalent to its CR.
* +N weapon/armor increases to-hit / AC by N.
* Advantage: Roll 2x, hit if any of the rolls hit.
* Attacks to HIDDEN target get Disadvantage: hit only when both rolls hit.
* Spend target's CR amount of XP and do REAL Task to PUNY hit the target.
* Attack roll against BOUND target can get extra +1/-1, without XP.
* If hero with DOOM rolls 19,20, make roll 1,
  At this moment hero can spend 10 XP (5 if CLEVER) to lose 1 DOOM. 
* When attacking TASK entities, weapon bonuses don't apply.
SPENDING XP (gained for spawning monsters, exploring tiles, and quests)
XP is shared among all heroes. Spend 10 XP (5 if CLEVER) to gain BRACED. Do Study cr1 frail insight task to give all monsters of the target's type the KNOWN tag till the next camping. Hero gains 2x the XP for spawning KNOWN monsters. Actor gains 1 XP each time it fails D20 Attack on odd roll.
On a natural roll of 19+ (attack or skill test), an actor with 10+ XP banked (8 if FULFILED) gains INFORMED.
Hero can also become INFORMED by spending 20XP.
Such actor can spend extra +1 XP to modify D20 Attack.
INFORMED actor with FOCUS above target's CR is guaranteed hit. And can spend KNOWN target's CR XP for permanent attack Advantage to it.
Expertise: INFORMED hero who rolled 20 on attack, can act again.

                                         D20 TILE
                             Index a d20 roll into the below table.
                   Exploring a tile grants you 1 XP, in addition to monster's CR XP.
     Tile has D4 Exits to other areas, + the way used to enter it.
         D4 EXITS:  1. N+SW;  2. S+NE; 3. W+SE; 4. E+NW.
    No unexplored exits? - Most north-west tile has unexplored exit.
    The KEY is valid only for this adventure.
    The adventure resets each time you retry it.
    See MONSTER SPAWNING when the result includes monsters.
First roll d6: 1. You know tile's content before entering.
2-3. If you're HIDING, same as 1, else monsters from there come to your tile. 4-6. Exploring hero enters the tile.
If d6 is odd, the tile also has a D20 Dungeon/D20 Wilds Prop
1. D20 Boss tile. If Wilds: Spawn monsters with +5 to spawn roll.
   If Dungeon: Hero entering this tile gains KEY for this adventure.
   if no boss/already found/defeted, spawn monsters with +5 to spawn roll.
2. Random Wilds D6 Biome monsters.
3. Random D12 Dwellers monsters
4-7. DWELLING. Spawn monsters.
8. AMBUSH. Spawn monsters - each with HIDING.
9. ENCOUNTER. D20 Encounter unless Sea adventure.
10-11. Ways forward are locked. REAL task to open them.
12-13. Ways forward is d6: 1-2. Flooded (be SWIMMER), 3-4. Chasm (be FLYER), 5-6. Elevated (be CLIMBER).
       Spend surge or have that tag to use these ways.
14-15. Ways back is d6: 1-2. Flooded (be SWIMMER), 3-4. Chasm (be FLYER), 5-6. Elevated (be CLIMBER).
       Spend surge or have that tag to use the way.
16. CRAMPED. Ways forward block LARGE or GIANT from passing
17. TIGHT (Dungeon only). Ways forward allows only SMALL actors entering.
18. PUZZLE. Way back locks once 1st hero enters. To open be INFORMED.
19. TRAP. If Wilds: D6 Animal. Kill it to gain RATION
    If Dungeon: Way back closes once 1st hero enters. To open have KEY,
    or have Sleight trained.
20. TREASURY. If Wilds: D6 Animal. Kill it to gain RATION
    If Dungeon: Has a Vault prop with d20+10 gp. Needs KEY to open.
            STRONG fighter can spend 2 SURGEs to open vault.
ESCAPING
To escape monsters, pick exit and roll a D20 Skill, do Task on that
skill to allow all heroes moving there, while monsters losing PURSUER.
The task is EASY if all monsters have CR < 3. If hero misses task, reroll its D20 Skill.
ELEVATION
The edge connecting the tiles has cliff-like elevation.
Be FLYER/CLIMBER to enter. Spend lander to gain CLIMBER.
If have rope do REAL Athletics to gain CLIMBER.
Else, HARD Athletics to gain CLIMBER.
REST
If no monster on adjacent tile, a hero can spend 3 XP to lose 1 TIRED and regains one daily power. At a DARK tile/area the cost is 5 XP, unless any hero has FIRE. Hero can't Rest in city adventure (pesky guards). On the world map Rest advances time to the next day.
MONSTER SPAWNING
If travel adventure, monsters spawn from Wilds, else - D12 Dwellers
In both cases add count of N explored tiles to the spawn d6 table roll.
If N is above 16, spawn monsters with N=16, i.e. d6 + 16.
Once told to spawn monsters, keep spawning while the double of their total CR is below the N. I.e. if we explored N=10 tiles, the single tile spawn can result in cr6 monster, or cr2 and cr3 monsters ((2+3)*2=10),
but not cr6 and cr5 monsters.
D20 MONSTER TYPE
    1-2 Aberrant
     3-4 Fey
    5-6 Beast
    7-8 Undead
  9-10 Demon
11-12 Plant
13-14 Reptile
15-16 Gizmo
17-18 Spirit
19-20 Humanoid
  Note: all Giants and Dragons are LARGE.
TASK
                             A Task is an entity like a monster, but represents a problem the
                     heroes are trying to solve. Task doesn't attack on its own, but
    auto-attacks the hero who misses it. Task's hit inflicts TIRED.
  EASY (E), REAL (R), HARD (H), ABSURD (A) - the task difficulty.
Task lists one or more D20 Skills, dictating which abilities and skill
training affects the strength against it. So a hero trained in Medicine
is STRONG against "Minor Illness. cr1 frail growing medicine task.".
If no skill specified, roll a random D20 Skill.
EASY tasks are CR1, PUNY and FRAIL unless overruled.
Actor without D6 Ability listing task's skill is PUNY against the task.
Actor with a D6 Lapse listing task's skill has Disadvantage against it.
E.g. CRAZY hero is PUNY and has Disadvantage to above Minor Illness task.
Non-TRAINED actor is MEEK against HARD/ABSURD tasks.
Task can't be attacked with usual powers - no kicking/fireballing illness.
By default hero can spend 1 XP to modify task attack roll by +1.
If powers/item gives +N to skill/action, you can spend extra N XP to modify.
If you miss task rolling 1-2, you can spend 5 XP to gain training in the skill.
You can spend N SURGEs to overcome a CR N task.
Example: Seeking governor audience cr1 persuasion task. Roll 13 into D20 Attack - failure because hero is non-INFORMED - task auto-hits you with normal hit - 2 TIRED (1 converts to HURT). You attack again rolling 1 - task hits you with 2 more TIRED, but hero spends 5XP, to gain PERSUASION tag. E.g. reflect on the failure: next time do better.

20. Concentration
 Concentration is the skill to focus attention for long periods of time.
DAILY CHASE
Chase to catch NPC / sabotage the villain's plan this day.
d4 tracks distance (starts random).  If chase is in progress, before each
camping heroes do REAL task to increase distance by 1. If heroes fail task,
 decrease it. If distance is 0, the heroes chase failed and any global pursuers
              will spawn on the 1st tile of the next adventure
SKILL RELATED ACTIONS
Having any training in specific skills, unlocks additional
at-will actions:
Cache: If you're risking to lose your items, spend 5 XP to make a cache at some world map area, storing any gp or items you carry. To retrieve the cache, be PREPARED, and at that area spend 5 XP to do EASY Survival.
Cure Illness: If PREPARED, do REAL Medicine task to lose ILL
Lore: when starting adventure do REAL History task to gain 5 XP.
Panhandling: If 3+ NPC on a tile, do EASY Performance to gain TRIFLE, REAL to gain 1gp. Can be done once per tile.
Pickpocket: do REAL Sleight task to pickpocket a non-Hostile/non-Annoyed NPC for its wage. 
Pray: Spend 10 XP and do HARD Religion to gain FAVOR
Tossing:  A STRONG hero can do REAL Athletics to toss non-LARGE target within 2 tiles. Ally thrown onto foe can use 1 at-will power against that foe.
Mounting: A LARGE humanoid can ride a MOUNT ally, like horse.
Mounting and dismounting takes an action. Attacks against mount hero go
to the mount. Mount can't use daily powers, while carrying hero.
CAMPING
If have 5 XP (and during adventure INFORMED + no monsters on tile), the heroes can return from current adventure, sleep and regain daily powers and end the day.
* Unless heroes have 15 or more XP, lose INFORMED
* For each 5 XP gain a SURGE and each hero loses HURT.
* Lose any surge over 3 + level-ups count.
* Lose 1/2 XP, all TIRED and RATIONs above 3.
* Swap Powers and flip on all the daily powers.
* Increase the days counter (1 when the game begins, use d20).
* If the days counter became 21, see New Month section.
NEW MONTH
Set days counter to 1 and Gain MONTH (see Game Over section)
Lawful hero with INFAMY loses FAVOR and gains DOOM.
Lose RATION or lose PREPARED, INFORMED and all SURGES.
 Note:  Our month has 20 days to simplify the rules. Days 3, 6, 9, 12,
             15 and 20 start at nighttime (22:00), which favors the night beings.
             Use D20 Map to map d20 day to 1-30 range.

HERO TAGS
                           CR: Hero is cr2, FULFILED hero - 3, EPIC - 5.
                                INFORMED hero has +2 to CR.
   FIRE: strips DARK from tiles and areas. On dungeon/night time
  exploration, this actor gains 2x XP, but also explores all adjacent tiles.
  Non-innate FIRE can be lost as at-will action.
DARK: any dungeon or nighttime wilds tile. DARK tile foes spawn HIDING.
FOCUS(max 9): Spent for specific acts. Instead of acting, Spend 1 XP to gain 1 FOCUS. Lose 1 FOCUS if gain HURT. Lose all FOCUS if leave tile. Monsters prioritize attacking the hero with the most FOCUS tags.
FULFILED: If have 2 or more FULFILED, you gain RENOWN.
    If hero leaves/dies, re-assign its FULFILED tags to other heroes.
   The goal of the game is to amass 10 FULFILED tags among all heroes.
LICH: This hero is UNDEAD and HEALING. For 10gp LICH can plant its Phylactery at specific dungeon area. The heroes can teleport there instead of losing adventure.
DOOM (max 3): How hard hero resists their fate.
ESSENCE: Godhod (see Apotheosis). You gain extra SURGE on camping.
FAVOR (max 3): spend 5XP and FAVOR to lose DOOM/MENTAL/ILL/3 TIRED and gain as many SURGEs as it has Levels. FULFILED hero Also loses DOOM when gains FAVOR.
INFAMY:  Disadvantage to any task at any non-SMALL city.
INFESTED: If HURT, on roll 1, you die (parasite hatches) - make new hero, transfering FULFILED tags. To lose INFESTED do TOUGH Medicine task.
PREPARED:  You came prepared. Lose PREPARED to gain 2 SURGEs.
RENOWN: Advantage on Persuasion inside city, or Disdvantage if INFAMY.
If the INVESTED plus DEPOSITED money exceed 100gp, gain RENOWN.
TRIFLE (max 3): Gain each time buy/sell anything for gp.
TIRED: how tired is the hero. Gain HURT instead of any TIRED tag over 3.
VOIDLICH: learn 4 more Epic and Ritual Spells, if gain 1 FOCUS, gain 2.
WORN: If 4+ WORN, lose WORN tags, and if no basic/magic armor/weapon gain HURT, otherwise lose basic weapon/armor.
CITY:WANTED: Heroes are wanted at specific city. Talk Disadvantage + Hostile guards at this city while that hero is in the party. On world map once a month per city, hero has innate action Spread False Trail:
HARD Deception to lose 1 INFAMY and WANTED at this city.
CITY:PATRON: 1st trade each month is free. Can open a business (see Real
           Estate). You don't get task Disadvantage / arrested or INFAMY
              at this city.
             CITY:FRIEND: Heroes can visit friend's house at this city (2xp).
                     Heroes have advantage to rolls against their friend.
D20 PROP
Placed upon exploring specific tiles. To use a prop, the Hero
should be on its tile and spend an action, making the prop USED.
Prop use gives 1 XP.
D20 DUNGEON PROP
1. Alchemist's Bench. Random D10 Flask item.
2. Altar: Heroes lose MENTAL. CLERIC regains daily power.
3. Bookcase: MAGE regains daily power.
4-5. Chest (Locked): Hero can unlock do cr4 HARD tough athletics sleight.
Opening grants 2x D20 Treasure.
6. Closet: ROGUE regains a daily power.
7. Fireplace: Heroes lose all TIRED and BOUND.
8. Mirror: Reveal 3 tiles, without spawning monsters
9. Sarcophagus. Roll d20: 1-8. A monster, 9-20. Roll a D20 Treasure.
10. Statue: Roll d20. 1-7 = gain DOOM; 8-20 = gain FAVOR.
11. Table: Roll d20: 1-10 = gain HURT; 11-20 = lose 2 HURT
12. Throne: Roll d20: 1-10 = gain HURT; 11-20 = gain SURGE.
13. Torture Rack: Roll a monster - your ally till the end of adventure.
14. Weapon Rack: FIGHTER regains daily power,
      All heroes lose UNARMED, UNARMORED and 1 WORN.
15. Lever. Roll d4:
      1. Opens Doors. Gain KEY.
      2. Closes water. Exits lose FLOODED, new exits - non-FLOODED.
      3. Draw Bridges. Exits lose CHASM, new exits - non-CHASM.
      4. Enable Elevators. Exits lose ELEVATED, new exits - non-ELEVATED.
16. Secret Stash. Do tough investigation task to gain 10gp.
17. Secret Exit. Do tough investigation task to return to world map.
18. Secret Way. Do tough investigation task to roll d4
    1-2. Next explored room is the BOSS room.
    3-4. Next explored room is the TREASURY room.
19-20. Mimic cr1 puny binder hunter hidden disguised trapper aberrant


D20 WILDS PROP
                             Appear in the wilds adventures. E.g. plains/forest.
                  
    1. Runestone. Heroes lose MENTAL. Druid regains daily power.
  2-3. Tree stump. Roll d4: 1. D20 Treasure; 2. Monsters.
 4-5. Tree with a hollow. d4: 1. d20 xp; D20 Treasure; 3. Monsters.
6. Bridge. All unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn FLOODED.
7. Spring. Lose all TIRED and ILL.
8. Ruins. Entrance to Five Room Dungeon. Going there ends this adventure.
9. Camp Tent. d4 D20 NPC with Odd default mood.
     The tent has 2 D20 Treasures, but NPCs get GUARD if hero uses it.
10. Portal. Informed DRUID can teleport allies on the destination.
11. Pit/Hole/Cave. If used, roll d20:
    1-5. Spawn monster from D6 Biome (add d20 to its roll).
    6-20. D20 Treasure  (add d20 to roll).
12. Cliffs. All unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn ELEVATED.
13. Mushrooms. If used, roll d20: 1-10. ILL+MENTAL. 11-15. RATION.
        16-20. Lose all TIRED and HURT. 16-20. Gain 1 FAVOR. 
        DRUID hero can identify the mushrooms.
14, Chasm. All unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn CHASMS.
15-17. Nothing.
18-20. Bush. Everyone is ROWBUST on this tile
             On use, gain d4: 1-2. ILL, 2. RATION
D10 HOUSE PROP
If hero uses a house, any NPC on tile becomes GUARD.
1. Mirror. Player picks any D20 NPC type to spawn.
2. Table. Roll d20: 8-15. Gain d10 XP. 16-20 has RATION.
3. Bed. Allows Camping, without paying for inn or leaving city.
4. Fireplace: Heroes lose all TIRED and BOUND.
5. Cupboard. Roll d20: 8-15. Gain d10 XP. 16-20: D20 Treasure
6. Boxes. Hold D20 Treasure.
7. Trinket worth d4 gp. E.g. silver plates or mounted animal head.
8-10. Nothing.
D20 CITY PROP
1. Sewer Grate If medium/large city (reroll if small).
    Start Sewer Biome adventure,  upon find BOSS or KEY tiles,
    you reach the destination of the enclosing city adventure.
2. Fountain. Spend TRIFLE to lose 1 DOOM
3. Cart/wagon. Holds D20 Treasure. If used, tile NPCs gain GUARD.
4. Statue. Spend 10 XP to gain 1 FAVOR.
5-6. d4-1 Robber(s) cr1 hiding slow puny trapper hunter humanoid. hostile.
7. Goat cr0 meek frail beast. Killing gives ration, but tile NPCs gain GUARD
8. d4 Dogs cr1 frail puny binder hunter pursuer beast. Roll d20:
       1-5. Start Hostile; 16-20. Friendly;
       6-15. PURSUERs who turn hostile if any NPC on tile is Annoyed.
9. Boxes. Holds 2 D20 Treasure. If used, tile NPCs gain GUARD
10. Bulletin Board. If used, spawn d4 TROUBLED D20 NPCs with quests.
11. Wall. All unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn ELEVATED.
12. Bridge All unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn FLOODED.
13. Gibbet Cage. If used, gain INFAMY and spawn a SOLICITING prisoner NPC,
     who gives d20 XP and their gp as a reward.
14. City Bell. Explore adjacent tiles, move NPCs from adjacent tiles here.
15. Pillory. Lose 10XP and donate 10gp to lose 1 INFAMY+WANTED.
16. Narrow. Unexplored exits beside the ones on this tile turn CRAMPED.
17-20. Trash Pile. You can rummage through it once. Roll d20:
       1-5. Gain ILL+HURT
     6-15. Nothing
   16-20. You found a D20 Treasure

D20 MUNDANE ITEM
                            Such item costs d10 gp. ARTIFICER can pay vending
                   blacksmith 4gp and do REAL Arcana to enchant the item, making
   it weightless - no carrying capacity decrease. Using item takes action.
1. Iron bar / Saw / Hammer / Spade. +2 to Intimidation.
* Allows REAL Athletics to remove TIGHT and TRAP exit blocks.
2. Rope. Do REAL Athletics to go through ELEVATED exit.
* Do REAL Sleight to gain BINDER till leave this tile.
3. Gadget / Coil / Fishing line and hook. +3 Sleight, +2 Investigation
4. Bucket/Pot. +2 Deception, +2 Investigation
* Remove flammable property from a tile.
* Immune to the first BLASTER attack from any SERPENT monster.
* Use fire elemental: instantly dies
* Spend to gain SHOCKER  and make any cr1-3 monster MENTAL.
5. Torch/Lantern. Use to gain FIRE.
6. Bag/Backpack/Sack. Advantage on Survival task.
* Increases hero's carrying capacity by 3. One sack per hero.
7. Utensils / Shears / Knife. +1 Sleight of Hand, +1 Survival
* Advantage to Break Free task.
* Spend to do gain 5 XP.
7. Herbs. When used, roll d20: 1-5. gain HURT; 6-10. lose 3 HURT.
                 11-20. lose MENTAL.
   Do EASY Nature to roll what herbs do before using them.
8. Ladder. Makes hero SLOW but allows to ignore ELEVATION.
9. Musical instrument. +3 Performance, +1 Taming
10. Antidote. All heroes on tile lose ILL.
11. Small Mirror. +1 Perception, +2 Persuasion
12. Garment. Advantage to Persuasion if garment costs more than 8gp
13. Blanket / Cloak. Advantage to Stealth, If no NPC or monster within 1 tile
 * Spend to gain SHOCKER and make non-LARGE/EPIC target MENTAL.
14. Food. gain RATION
15. Trinket. Worthless item you can only sell. Spend to gain 1 XP.
16. Donkey cr1 puny beast
 * Increases owner carry limit by 7. Max one donkey for all heroes.
  
17. Scroll. Roll d20:
  1-10. D20 Cantrip Scroll
  11-15. Scroll with D20 Common Mage Spell
  16-20. Scroll with D20 Common Cleric Spell
  If scroll costs less than 4gp, there is a 50% chance the cast will fail.
18-19. D10 Flask (see next page)
20. D6 Toolkit
D6 TOOLKIT
Each toolkit costs 4gp. Unusable if share tile with a monster.
Having training in the use of these tools allows doing EASY task and spending 2 days to produce Trinket, which you can sell.
1. Alchemist Kit. Each Alchemist kit has d20 uses and can't be recharged
* Do REAL Investigation to create Antidote or D10 Flask.
  On failure roll d20: 1-5. Alchemist Kit explodes: lose it and gain 2 HURT.
* Do REAL Investigation to perform a D20 Cantrip
2. Carpentry Kit. +1 Investigation.
* Unless at desert/city/dungeon: do REAL task to craft ladder, bucket, torch.
* Unless at city, spend 15 XP to do epic tough survival task to build a cabin.
  Cabin replaces the usual campfire prop, and stores up to 30 items.
  Existence of cabin at area gives +1xp per explored tile.
  Each time you re-enter the area, roll d20:
    1. It hosts now d4 D20 NPCs. Each with Odd default mood.
        They gain GUARD if you use cabin to get back your items.
    2. Items got plundered.
    3. Cabin is no longer here.
3. Masonry Kit. +2 Investigation.
* Allows HARD Investigation to create extra exit (one per tile)
* Allows REAL Investigation to remove Elevation from tile exit.
4. Smith Tools. +1 Investigation
* Do REAL Investigation to remove all WORN
* Do HARD Investigation to gain POLISH
* Do REAL to craft a Gadget mundane item.
* If trained Investigation, spend to open Vault without a KEY.
5. Scribe Kit. +2 Investigation.
* Scribe a scroll with a D20 Common Spell you know.
  That spell could be used without flipping a daily power
* Pick NPC and do REAL History to forge document, giving you +d20 Persuasion against that NPC. After you used forged document, roll d20:
  1-10. NPC becomes Annoyed on the next day. If NPC was Official or Lord,
    you also gain 2 INFAMY and WANTED that day.
6. Adventurer's Backpack:
* Spend 5 XP and do REAL Survival to gain PREPARED.
D10 FLASK
                            Flasks are spent on use. Target yourself or ally on your tile.
                            1-2. Lesser Potion of Healing (2gp): lose 3 HURT
                            3-4. Potion of Recovery (5gp): Discard MENTAL and ILL.
    5. Oil Flask (4gp). Spend to make this/adjacent tile Flammable.
    6. Dreammist. Lose a level to d20: 1-10: reroll D20 Flaw, else - Virtue.
         Do REAL Deception to sell it to any vending mood NPC for d10 gp,
         but gain WANTED the next day. You can report NPC selling you this.
    7. Potion of Stamina (TRIFLE). Lose 2 TIRED.
    8. Potion of Speed (1gp). Till Camping act 2 times/turn with Disadvantage
      to any roll. If get Disadvantage - act once. Advantage? - no Disadvatage.
    9. Potion of Rejuvenation (2gp) Flip one of your used powers.
  10. Potion of Healing (5gp). Lose all HURT and gain 2 SURGEs.
D20 TREASURE
You add the unspent XP to this roll. Unless overruled, items are usable at any moment during Hero Phase, don't consume action/attack/move. Discard potions and scrolls after use. 
1-20: D20 Mundane Item
22. Roll d4: 1. Bracers of Defense (10gp): Blocks the 1st hit after each camp
   2. Elven Cloak (10gp): Spend tile monster's CR XP to Escape.
   3. Diary (20gp, can't be sold): Level up the hero and discard.
   4. Lucky Charm (12gp): Use on any dice roll. Make it succeed.
23-25. Minor Precious Item (10gp):
29. Roll d4: 1. +1 Magic Armor (20gp): +2 to modify foe's attack.
                    2. +1 Magic Weapon (20gp): +2 to-hit against adjacent target.
                    3. +1 Bow (20gp): +1 to-hit against non-adjacent target.
                    4. Boots of Striding (20gp): Allows moving twice.
32-33. Precious Item (20gp): worthless item you can only sell.
36. Major Precious Item (40gp): worthless item you can only sell.
38. Ring of Shooting Stars (40gp): Any monster on tile gains 2 HURT. Flip off after use till next day.
39. Rare Magic Item. Roll d6: 
    1. Gauntlets of Ogre Power (40gp): +1 HURT to you melee attack.
    2. Pearl of Power (40gp): Flip on one of your used powers or items.
        Flip this item off after use till next camping.
    3. +2 Magic Weapon (30gp): +3 to-hit with melee attacks.
   4. Staff of the Elements - 30gp: +3 to-hit  with ranged attacks
            Usable only by mages.
ITEMS CARRY LIMIT
In dungeon hero can carry unlimited number of items.
But on world map normal hero is limited by 5 items, PUNY - 3,
STRONG - 8. Any item above adds extra 5 XP to travel requirements.
TRADING ITEMS BETWEEN HEROES
Each hero tracks an empathy trade balance value (starts at 0).
Giving an item to another hero: the balance decreases by the item's GP cost. The receiving hero's balance increases by the item's GP cost.
Finding loot: If the balance is negative, reduce the deficit by the loot's GP value (balance moves toward 0, but not above 0).
Camping increases negative balance by 1 (moves 1 closer to 0).
A hero with negative balance refuses to give items to other heroes.
Note: the ownership of dropped items is maintained.
Example: Hero A (balance 0) gives a 50gp sword to Hero B (balance 0). Now A has balance -50, B has balance +50. Hero A can't give anything until their balance recovers. If A finds a 20gp treasure, balance goes from -50 to -30. Each camp also recovers 1, so -30 -> -29.
CRAFTING
Given unconscious monster, hero can do REAL Survival to
obtain that monster's material item whose crafting value
equals monster CR. The monster dies in the process.
Back at city, an Artificer scholar can convert 4 crafting items into a D20 Treasure, where you add total crafting items value to the d20 roll.
ITEM IDENTIFICATION
When you equip unidentified item which costs 20+ gp roll d20: 1-5, the item is cursed, and must roll D20 Torment, which lasts till item is removed. Cursed item can be removed at temple, discarding that torment. Find appropriate Scholar or do HARD History to identify if the item.
ITEM ACTIONS
Throwing Items:  As bonus action hero can throw carried item, making target lose its turn on hit (use D20 Attack for resolution).
Flammable: Oil Flask makes tile flammable. FIRE entity auto ignites a flammable tile, which now AGILE attacks each resident at start of
that resident's phase. If tile has water, discard flammable mark,
Fire Poke: Lose FIRE to gain SHOCKER and make MENTAL any non-EPIC BEAST.
CITY ADVENTURE
                            Like normal Adventure, but place City Tiles.
     Upon entering city area, lose all PREPARED and SHIP tags.
  If WANTED, Disadvantage to any task (see Arrest if lose city adventure).
If you attack NPC and the 1st attack roll is 1-2, the NPC is ODD - roll D20 Twist, Good hero gains 1 DOOM for any non-EVIL NPC killed. At night all non-Guard NPCs are drunkards (if 1-10), or thugs (11-20).
CITY TILES: Follow normal D20 Tile layout, but props come out of  D20 City Prop, and only AMBUSH/ENCOUNTER tiles spawn monsters (D12 Dwellers civilized biome). When hero explores a new tile, they are given choice to spend XP making next tile...
* City Entrance (start here). If WANTED + MEDIUM/LARGE, exits are
   ELEVATED and tile has d4 Guards (d6 if LARGE).
* Street (0 XP, default). Usual D20 Tile, but every exit needs D6 City
   Task to unlock. If even D20 Tile, spawn 1 D20 NPC.
* Family House (2 XP). Has all hero's relatives if this is hero's home city.
* House (3 XP). Each house has d4 NPCs and D20 House Prop.
* Questgiver House (5 XP). Has a TROUBLED NPC.
* Tavern (10 XP) Innkeeper Special NPC and LEISURE 5 D20 NPCs.
* Center (6 XP) d6+2 of D20 NPCs and 2 D20 City Prop
* Lord's Castle Gate (12XP, MEDIUM/LARGE city only).The gate is closed:
     exit is Elevation.  If LARGE the gate has 5 guards, MEDIUM - 3.
     Gate has exit to a D20 Civilized Adventure, whose BOSS is the Lord
     Special NPC. If the RENOWN or succeed ABSURD Persuasion, heroes
     get transferred directly to the lord's tile.
* Travel Guild (6XP) Portmaster Special NPC and d4 Stranger NPCs.
City can have unlimited number of houses and streets, but all other locations are unique.
NPC INTERACTION OPTIONS
If NPC is BUSY/HOSTILE/ANNOYED/NOISY, only the Distract option is available. Noisy NPC makes other NPC on tile NUMB.
For CAPTIVE NPC only Free and Interrogate options are available.
Options beside Chat and Distract can be done only once.
* Study cr1 frail insight task. Make NPC KNOWN, roll NPC's D20 Gender/Orientation, learn D20 Faction and alignment (see D20 Map).
* Trade (if VENDING) cr1 frail persuasion task. Allows trading for a single
    Wares item. If you buy/sell anything, gain TRIFLE (small change money).
    Vending NPC can buy any item for 1/2 price, if have the gp.
             * Appraise tough persuasion task to gain 1gp discount on this tile
                and if item costs 1gp, it now costs TRIFLE.
* Chat (no task if LEISURE) cr1 frail random-skill task.
   You gain 2XP, NPC loses LEISURE.
   Roll D20 Mood for the NPC.
   1. NPC is ODD - roll D20 Twist.
   2. NPC is NOISY now.
   3-4. NPC is BUSY now.
   5-9. NPC becomes ANNOYED (or GUARD if already annoyed),
          and guards within 1 tile gain PURSUER.
   10-11. NCP gains VENDING.
   12-13. NPC is FUNDRAISER
   14. NPC is SOLICITING
   15-20. NPC is TROUBLED
* Extort cr1 tough intimidation task. That NPC's gp.
* Defraud cr2 deception task. Get NPC's GP.
* Intimidate cr2 intimidation task. NPC becomes TIMID.
  If this task gives you HURT, the NPC becomes Hostile.
* Investigate cr2 tough investigation task. Once task is done, Roll d20:
   1-10. NPC is ODD - roll D20 Twist.
* Hire (if SOLICITING) cr1 persuasion task. See Hiring NPC.
* Donate (if FUNDRAISER) Give NPC it's salary gp for XP 5x that gp.
* Quest (if TROUBLED) NPC has D20 Quest for you.
* Share Drink (if drunkard or at tavern).
    Spend BOOZE to gain 4 xp and auto pass the Chat task. 
* Distract cr2 persuasion intimidation deception task.
  You gain 4 XP, NPC loses BUSY/HOSTILE/ANNOYED/NOISY
  If you miss this task, rolling 1-3, NPC is ODD - roll D20 Twist.
* Help (if BUSY). Spend 5XP to gain their wage gp
* Report (ODD+PROVEN NPC) Spawns a Guard and makes the NPC
   CAPTIVE, while you gain NPC's wage gp.
   Lawful hero gains FAVOR for reporting NPC, but chaotic gains DOOM.
   Note: You can't report lord, noble or official.
* Steal (once per NPC). cr2 sleight task. Get that NPC's single wares item.
* Bribe (If  know NPC's faction). Pay bribe gp to gain 4x that gp XP.
* Deceive. cr2 deception task. If any two NPC's on tile have different
   factions, give all NPCs on tile gain BRAWLER. Good heroes gain DOOM.
* Interrogate (CAPTIVE NPC or monster if know monster language)
  Intimidation task to gain 4*CR XP. Undead (beside liches/vampires),
  gizmo, beasts can't be interrogated. Good heroes gain DOOM from this act.
* Free. CAPTIVE npc/monster disappears. Non-evil heroes lose DOOM.
D20 NPC
                            The N gp is the NPC's wage and gp they carry. 
                            Each NPC is cr1 humanoid and has a random D6 Lapse.
  1. Beggar puny 1gp fundraiser rebel. D20 Skill.
   * Impoverished or older person who fails to provide for itself.
   * Wares: see Agent Services
2. Drunkard 2gp leisure D20 Skill rebel.
* Lose BOOZE to gain Advantange to D20 Talk to Drunkard.
3. Preacher 3gp noisy religion zealot.
* Wares: See Temple Wares section below.
4. Performer agile 3gp noisy fundraiser performance rebel.
* Street artist. Draws crowds and rumors.
* When spawned, add additional d3 NPCs (per Performer) to the tile.
5. Servant 5gp busy sleight loyalist. - A tired slave or a maid on errand.
6-7. Guard tough puny coward 4gp busy perception loyalist spawns(guard)
* Becomes Hostile (see Special Mood), if shares tile and you:
  * WANTED at this city or INFAMY, but no Disguised condition.
  * Cast non-cantrip spells on the same tile, without a PATRON,
* Guards at SMALL/PATRON cities ignore INFAMY if not WANTED locally.
8. Farmer 7gp vending nature separatist.
* Brings goods to market. May have rural news.
* Wares: RATION (1gp).
9. Forager 6gp vending survival separatist.
* Hunter/Fisherman/Herbalist. Tells tales of beasts and wilderness.
* Wares: 2x RATION (3gp), Learn Monster Language (4gp see Monster Talk)
10. Scholar, 10gp busy vending investigation aloof
* Wares: D20 Scholar Service
11. Blacksmith strong 8gp busy athletics pragmatic. Wares:
 * Repair (1gp). Lose all WORN.
 * Basic Weapon (5gp). Lose UNARMED.
 * Basic Armor (5gp). Lose UNARMORED.
 * Polish Equipment (10 gp). Gain POLISH.
 * Enchant (10gp): HARD Arcana to stop item from going WORN.
12. Artisan 2+d10 gp busy D20 Skill pragmatic
 * Wares: see Artisan Wares section below
16. Thug strong d10 gp annoyed intimidation pragmatic
   * Rough looking person; Instead of Afraid becomes Hostile
   * Wares: random D20 NPC wares.
  13. Official valued social 10gp annoyed insight loyalist.
                * Wares:  * Lose this city's WANTED and 1 INFAMY (10gp)
                * Audience with Lord (10gp). Spawns Lord and 3 guards.
14. Noble valued clever 12gp annoyed history loyalist.
* LEISURE if you got 8+ gp garment D20 Mundane Item 
* Wares: Offers estate for 60gp at D20 Map / DIR location.
         Estate is considered a cleared D20 Dungeon.
         You must spend additional 100gp to establish a Stronghold there.
15. Merchant social d20 gp vending persuasion pragmatic

17. Adventurer d10 gp soliciting aloof. Run Hero Generation if interact.
* A mercenary or an aspiring adventurer.

 * Unusual accent or attire. Assumes stats of D20 NPC on interaction.

SPECIAL NPC (have special spawn rules)
Innkeeper easy 4gp vending insight pragmatic
  * Wares: Innkeeper Wares (see Vendors and Wares)

  * Lease a Ship (6gp): gain SHIP.
  * Buy an OWNSHIP (200gp) with QUALITY of 5. See Ship Ownership.

                * Gain ownership over this city for a MONTH:
                * 100gp - small city, 200gp - medium, 400gp - large city.
D20 FACTION (To change known NPC's faction, do TOUGH persuasion task)
Learning NPC's faction unlocks bribery action at them.
    1-2. Loyalist. Bribe costs 4x wage.
    3-4. Zealot. Can't be bribed.
    5-6. Aloof. Bribe costs 2x wage
    7-8. Pragmatic.  Bribe costs its wage.
  9-10. Separatist. No bribe required. You get 4xp for free.
11-12. Rebel. No bribe required. You get 8xp for free.
13-20. Expected default faction. Aloof if unstated.

                                               D20 TWIST
                            Once NPC gains ODD, do its D20 Twist Reveal section.
                            Unless NPC is KNOWN do Aware section too, targeting
                            the active hero. Solve task becomes possible.

1. Blackmailer. Reveal: heroes lose all XP.
  Aware: Either hero gives all gp. or NPC escapes + all other NPCs are
    ANNOYED till the next camping, while daily chase distance is set to 0.
  Solve (HARD): blackmail them back, gaining d20 gp.
2. Cultist. Worships some evil god, or prepares a revolution.
  Reveal: All NPCs on this tile have Cultist D20 Twist.
  Aware: All cultists are now Hostile.
  Solve (REAL): Leaves the cult, you gain d10 XP
3. Deranged. E.g. mentally ill, drug abuser, etc...
  Reveal: It gains EPIC.
  Aware: Becomes Hostile.
  Solve (REAL): seeks mental help, you gain 4XP and its wage.
4. Emissary. E.g. spy, saboteur or informant for some faction.
  Reveal: For each Hero but FOUNDER roll d20,
               1-2 = that hero serves the same faction,  and leaves unless LOYAL.
  Aware: Heroes lose all SURGEs, while the NPC disappears.
  Solve (REAL): uncovering the spy gives you d20 gp reward;
5. Fence. Buys stolen goods.
  Reveal: All other NPCs on this tile are now ODD.
  Aware: Disappears.
  Solve (EASY):  * Lose TITHE (sell stolen goods) to gain d20 gp.
                          * Lose TRIFLE to buy Thieves Tools
6. Hustler. Swindler, pimp, etc...
   Aware: Every hero loses 1/2 their gp.
   Solve (REAL): you learn about a fraud scheme - gain d20 XP
7. Monster (in Disguise).
  Reveal: you know it's HARD EPIC and it's D12 Dweller monster type.
  Aware: Replace this NPC with actual monster.
              The monsters consider NPCs to be foes.
  Solve (Monster Talk): Gain its NPC wage + d20 XP and it disappears.

8. NPC is MENTAL
  Reveal: The next ODD NPC is responsible for the curse.
               If the NPC gets reported or in COMA, gain CURE
  Aware: Disappears.
  Solve (no MENTAL/have CURE): lose CURE, gain 20 XP and 2x their wage.
9. Smuggler. Aware: Escapes.
  Solve (REAL): The Nexus job (see NPC Specific Quest).
10. Thief. Aware: Hero loses all treasures. The NPC disappears.
  Solve (EASY): lose TRIFLE to gain TITHE (stolen goods).
11-12. Brawler.  Aware: All NPCs on tile gain BRAWLER
  Solve (REAL): re-roll the mood of all NPCs on tile.
13-20. No twist. NPC becomes ANNOYED (or GUARD if already
             annoyed), and guards within 1 tile gain PURSUER.
A PSION hit at 3 can, instead of damage, make the NPC ODD.
Wish spell or PSION hit at 6 allow you to pick the Twist and Faction.
TRACKING NPC
Do investigation task to respawn the NPC who stole your gp or treasure. If you now report or put this NPC into COMA, you regain the stolen stuff. 
PROMOTING NPC
Non-hero hired NPC can be promoted (10gp) to a D6 Class hero (see hero generation).
SIDEKICKS
Sidekick is an NPC traveling with a hero who recruited it. Unless overruled. A sidekick  can be ordered to stay at specific city or rejoined with the hero. The party can't have more than 4 sidekicks.
ADVANCEMENT TOKENS
Offered by scholars. Lv.N hero can have up to N advancement tokens. The next token of  same type costs 2x more.
Reroll (18gp): reroll any die rolled during your Hero Phase.
Reroll Odd (30gp): you can keep rerolling as long as the roll is odd.
Extra Hurt (16gp): used after you hit deal 1 extra HURT.
+5 Attack: used after you roll a die to add/subtract a value in 1-5 range.
Heal (12gp): use to lose HURT.
Recharge (14gp): recharge any Power or Treasure, enabling another use.
Advancement token use takes no an action.
Used token is disabled till next action next Camping.

VENDORS AND WARES
                             NPC specifies no wares? - has one D20 Treasure + xp/5
                   SMALL city vendors don't sell/buy items costing more than 5gp.
    MEDIUM - 15gp. Inappropriate items are replaced with 15. Trinket.
  You can Sell Items at a half of their price. You can't sell for more than
 NPC's wage (3x wage if merchant), but can barter for wares NPCs have.
INNKEEPER WARES (The d4 and d6 gp once rolled persist till end of adventure)
* Buy Food (d4 gp): the party gains RATION
* Buy Drink (1gp): gain BOOZE, spent o auto-pass the 1st talk to tavern NPC
* Ask about Rumor (TRIFLE): gain d6 XP (once a day)
* Rent a Room (d6 gp): end adventure, regaining all SURGEs.
ARTISAN WARES (Roll d20 to see what this specific artisan offers)
1-10.  Supplies (6gp): the party gains PREPARED.
11-12. Sells single D6 Toolkit (10gp)
13-15. Prepare Against D6 Biome (4gp). +4 to any roll at that biome,
            1 biome at time max.  Lose it if lost PREPARED.
16-17. Weapon (2gp): extra 1 HURT against D20 Monster Type
19-20. Armor (20gp): D20 Monster Type deals PUNY damage to wearer.
TEMPLE WARES
* Pray: TRIFLE and REAL Religion task to gain FAVOR.
* Heal (2gp). Remove BOUND/MENTAL/ILL/INFESTE/DHURT (all heroes)
* Determine Hero's Alignment (4gp): Roll into D20 Map.
* Remove Cursed Item (10gp).
* Donate D20 Legendary Item to gain 3 FAVOR.
HIRING NPC
Hiring soliciting NPC is 2x its wage. Some NPCs join for free. NPC gives Advantage to the skill it lists. Pay NPC's wage each month or they leave
D20 SCHOLAR SERVICE
Each scholar offers a single service type. If you hire the
scholar, you will have access to their service between adventures.
1-2. Adventurer's Guild. Trains heroes.
   * Overcome Lapse (30gp). FULFILED hero can lose any lapse.
   * Multiclass (20gp, once per hero): can equip powers of other D6 Class.
      You can pick 1 power now, and later through Learn New Hero Power,
3-4. Mentor. Teaches new Hero Power (2gp * number of powers you know):
   Roll into D12 Class Power to see what power this scholar teaches.
   Also sells Advancement Token. See respective section.
5-6. Arena. Once per city, given M ARENAWIN tags,
  fight against CR=(M+2)*4 monsters from random D12 Dwellers biome.
  If won, gain ARENAWIN and gp in the CR amount multiplied by 4.
7-8. University.
  * Train D20 Skill (5gp). Must have D6 Ability supporting the skill.
  * Hire Engineer (7gp). Gain ENGINEER (see D20 Inventive Solution)
  * Artificer Training (20gp). Gain ARTIFICER: +5 to crafting
       D20 Treasure roll and using Carpenter's Tool.
   * Learn Investment (20gp): gain INVESTOR.
9-10. Magic Guild. Learn random D20 Common Mage Spell (10gp).
   Learn Random Ritual Spell (40gp), A scholar teaches 1 specific spell
       D20 Ritual. MAGE can know only 2 such spells, but FULFILED - 3.
11-12. Thieves Guild.
   * Information (1gp): gain INFORMED
   * Learn Scouting (20gp) gain SCOUT.
13-14. Casino. Allows Gamble (6gp). Roll d20 to determine prize:
    0-15 nothing, 16-17 - 10gp, 18 - 20gp, 19 - 30gp, 20 - 40gp
15-16. Bank Deposit/Withdraw: Each hero has private deposit and cities
   share the bank system. Withdrawing money costs 1 gp per 10gp withdrawn. 
   If the deposited money by all heroes exceeds 100gp,  gain RENOWN.
   INVESTOR hero has 10%/month growth on the deposited money.
17-18. Temple.  * Temple Wares (see previous page)
                            * Blessing (20gp). Once per hero. +1 max surges.
19-20. Expert. Identify an Item (10gp). Say if item is cursed or not,
        and the D20 Torment associated with it.

At MEDIUM and LARGE city, heroes can place a house with specific scholar for 12XP. Each such house has scholar NPC and 2 guards.
                                        D20 QUEST
                            Once succeed quest, gain quest giver wage gp and 6XP.
                         Refuse reward? - Gain extra 6 XP
    1. Lost a Pet (next D20 NPC roll 17+ is their pet instead).
      Pet is NUMB and PURSUER (till on the same tile as this NPC).
      Goal: Bring pet to the NPC's tile.
2. Bullied by other NPCs (next D20 NPC roll 16+ is gang leader).
  Other NPCs on the gang leader's tile are part of the gang.
  Each gangster's a Thug with Odd default Mood.
  Goal: report, TIMID or COMA the gang leader.
3. Infestation. The Epic Rats Swarm spawns.
  Goal: defeat Rats Swarm cr3 epic agile epic swarm vorous binder beast
4. Refugee needs getting to any other city. Once there alive, gain 2*d20 gp.
5. Lost. Goal: do cr1 investigation task to show them direction.
6. Accused for what other NPC did (next NPC roll 16+ is culprit).
  The culprit's default Mood is Odd.
  Goal: Report that NPC to a guard (see above).
7. Demonic Possession cr4 dementer charmer arcane religion task
   for extra d12 gp and d20 xp.
8. Plague spreading on the streets. All heroes gain ILL.
  Goal: do cr3 growing blaster medicine task to gain d20*2 gp
9. Monster EPIC D12 Dwellers monster spawns. Goal: defeat the monster.
10. Minor Illness cr1 frail growing medicine task for extra d10 gp
11. Present. Give this NPC a trinket for d20 XP.
12. Detective Quest. See next page.
13. Missing NPC Quest. Do adventure  adjacent Wilds area - 8th tile will have that NPC with PURSUER tag. Get that NPC to the start tile for 20gp
14-20. See NPC Specific Quest
DETECTIVE QUEST
Find the culprit. Now when chat to NPC, you also learn clue about culprit, roll d4: 1.Old, 2.Burly, 3.Poor, 4.Merry. Each NPC can give a single clue,
but if that NPC is ODD the clue at that position can't be known. Once you
think you have enough clues (according to next page table), pick and report that NPC, then roll d2 to determine missing clues. If you had all clues or guessed right, collect 20 gp and 10xp. Otherwise spawn actual culprit ODD D20 NPC and do its Reveal and Aware.

CULPRIT       OLD   BURLY  POOR   MERRY
Drunkard      Yes   Yes    Yes    Yes
Blacksmith    Yes   Yes    No     Yes
Official      Yes   Yes    No     No
Scholar       Yes   No     No     No
Merchant      Yes   No     No     Yes
Beggar        Yes   No     Yes    No
Preacher      Yes   No     Yes    Yes
Forager       No    No     No     No
Performer     No    No     No     Yes
Child         No    No     Yes    Yes
Servant       No    No     Yes    No
Farmer        No    Yes    Yes    Yes
Thug          No    Yes    Yes    No
Noble         No    Yes    No     Yes
Guard         No    Yes    No     No
No match? - It is the closest: Stranger
NPC TASK ADVANTAGE 
Gain advantage against any specific task, if you share tile with NPC you did Chat task with and know it's alignment, and the NPC is:
* LAWFUL: Persuasion Advantage, unless you're CRAZY.
* CHAOTIC: Deception Advantage, unless you're WISE.
* GOOD: Advantage to this NPC's tasks if you HURT, FRAIL or has 3 TIRED.
* EVIL: Intimidation Advantage if actor is not HURT, FRAIL or has 3 TIRED.
* FRAIL/PUNY: Advantantage against this NPC's Intimidation tasks.
* CRAZY: Advantage against this NPC's tasks if you're CLEVER.
* DUMB: Advantage against this NPC's tasks if you're WISE.
* LONER: Disadvantage to this NPC's tasks unless you're SOCIAL.

                                      NPC SPECIFIC QUEST
                            See this section when rolled 15-20 on D20 Quest.
                       * Drunkard/Innkeeper. TREASURY in the next dungeon you
                          explore has a legendary item.
 * Merchant:  seeks mercenaries to deliver goods to next explored city.
   If accepted, gain GOODS. Once there, lose GOODS, collect 30gp reward.
   Merchant pays for any SHIP you lease.  Can't have more than 1 GOODS.
   While you have GOODS,  add +2 to monster spawn rolls
   If you throw away the GOODS, gain INFAMY.
* Fence/Smuggler D20 Twist: The Nexus seeks mercenaries to smuggle
   CARGO. Same as the below Merchant quest, but payment is 60gp.
   Upon accepting any Nexus job, gain 1 INFAMY.
   If already completed a smuggle, this NPC also has offer quests:
   1. Assassinate  a powerful random hero, who spawns here and is EPIC and
      INFORMED  (see Hero Generation). Payment is the is 10+d10 gp.
   2. Buy d10 Dreammist flasks (1 gp each). See D20 Mundane Item.
* Guard. Report 2 ODD NPCs for extra d20 gp.
* Official. You learned something which may interest officials at next city.
   Once at newly explored city speak with officials to gain d20 gp.
* Noble. defeat BOSS at the next explored dungeon for 40gp 
* Thug. Roll d20;
   1-10. Do Prison Break to free d4 Thugs, who once freed are your friends.
   11-20. A person is held for ransom at the next dungeon.
            Once there see Dungeons of Nymara / BNDTHDOUT.
* Artisan. Spend 2gp to bring ARTWORK to next city for 20gp reward.
  The ARTWORK can be sold for 1gp and good heroes gaining DOOM.
* Any other NPC. Help completing task with that NPC's skill.
  E.g.  Athletics task for Blacksmith.
PRISON BREAK
1. Do tough survival task to break into D12 Dwellers / D20 Civilized.
2. Fight through d10+5 Tiles, to find the inmate(s).
3. 3 monsters spawn chasing you. do task athletic task to escape prison.
D20 HOSPITALITY ADVENTURE
9-20. No Adventure. It was just a cheap place.
1-2. You got drugged and kidnapped - lost 10 days and move to last RISKY
     area (current area if none is risky), with adventure started with no return from 
     the start tile.
            3-4. A D20 Boss monster spawns with DISGUISED tag.
            5-8. Gain 1 HURT after resting due to unhealthy conditions.
CITY ACTIVITIES
RESTING FOR CHEAP
Talk with any VENDING NPC, the next house will have NPC
offering cheap rest (for TRIFLE): Do Camping, but next day you roll into D20 Hospitality Adventure (see previous page).
PURSUER GUARDS
If you make anyone Annoyed, you have two options: resist or the guards pursuing hero will beat the hero (HURT per guard), confiscating carried gp.
KILLING NPC
If any NPC is present within 1 tile, the non-Guard NPCs within 1 tile are Afraid, while you gain 1 INFAMY and WANTED (at this city), unless proven the NPC's D20 Twist or it attacked you first. Loot corpse for NPC's wage.
Killing non-ODD NPC gives 3 DOOM to each GOOD hero. 
FINDING SPECIFIC D20 NPC (LARGE cities only)
Talk to a Leisure/Vending  NPCs. Instead of that NPC rerolling mood, the next explored tile will have the NPC type you're looking for.
AGENT SERVICES
Pay TRIFLE to Child/Beggar in a Leisure/Vending mood to hire it as a hero (till end of adventure). This agent can't attack, but can talk and buy, taking all the blame for the actions. The agent suffers negative results from Twist's reveal, e.g. guard PURSUER.
PROSTITUTION
Given a non-LAWFUL hero for an LEISURE NPC do performance task. On success roll NPC's D20 Gender/Orientation, and if NPC's orientation matches hero's gender, gain NPC's gp. Otherwise NPC becomes ANNOYED. 
Note: hero learns NPC's orientation by Study talk option.
ARREST
On arrest, all your gp and items are confiscated, you're thrown into closest city jail. For the N of INFAMY tags, you're fined: N*40gp.
If the confiscated property covers that sum, you're released. Else you're sentenced to N*2 months of prison, On release lose all INFAMY, gain 1 DOOM and lose a level.
PRISON ESCAPE
Once a month, the arrested heroes can attempt escape, spawning at full health without weapons in a Civilized D12 dungeon and must go through d8 + INFAMY*2 count tiles of it to escape and spawn at this area's camp site.
D20 CITY ISSUE
                             Each time you roll 1 in any city, roll here,
                     record current city and the issues letters as you get them.
    1-4. V = Vanished People. Roll 3 times into D20 NPC.
                   These NPC types are no longer present - don't spawn them.
    5-8. O = Odd Activity/Symbols (Disadvantage to any talk).
  9-12. D = Disrupted Trade/Services (vendors have 2x prices).
13-16. S = Strangers Spotted (all NPCs have Odd default mood).
17-20. N = No issue bit this time.
Once got 4 letters, all the cities with issues gain City Villain Plot (see next page) with issue bits corresponding to collected letters. Now once you roll 1, the Effect section of the plot triggers, while you start assembling a new set of 4 letters.
While having 4 letters, but before d20 rolls 1, do tough task to block the Effect in the City Villain Plot.
After d20 rolls 1, while having 4 letters, heroes can do Five Room Dungeon to defeat D20 Boss clearing all issues from these cities and gain FULFILED and 2 LORE. That dungeon Hall's always has a D20 Boss.
If you get 2+ city villain plots at once, roll D6 Global Issue. It will disappear, once less than 2 city issues.
D6 GLOBAL ISSUE
1. World Conflict: each city has 50% of  conflict: NPCs have no gp.
    Yet other cities are got richer: NPC have 2x the gp, services cost 2x the gp.
2. Dragons from different biomes are roaming the countryside.
    Upon starting D6 Biome adventure, roll d20:
    1-10: spawn a dragon from another D6 Biome.
3. Giants from different biomes are pillaging the countryside.
   On a city visit, roll D20: 1-10. A D6 Biome giant at the entrance.
4. D6 Biomes is spreading. All odd X areas are now that biome.
5. Cataclysm: Disadvantage to any travel.
6. Invasion: each time you leave city, roll d20:
    1-10. Spawn d8 of D12 Dwellers monsters on your tile.

CITY VILLAIN PLOT
For each issue letter write 1 (random if missing) and match
the reveal, doing REAL Chase to avoid its Effect.
   V O D S  REVEAL
   0 0 0 0  You're on a false trail.  Effect: gain MONTH.
   0 1 0 0  Villain brainwashes locals. Preachers are EPIC + GUARD
      Effect: All NPCs are GUARD
   0 1 0 1  A portal spawns minions. NPC are all BUSY
      Effect: Instead of Stranger NPCs, spawn D12 Dwellers monsters
                 which attack NPCs, and if none - you.
   0 1 1 0  Insurgency. All NPCs are ANNOYED
      Effect: All NPC gain BRAWLER
   0 1 1 1  Economic sabotage. All Artisans and Merchants are now Beggars.
      Effect: You can't buy anything.
   0 0 1 0   Overtaxed economy. All NPCs are ANNOYED
                  Leaving city during day REAL at entrance to avoid paying 10gp.
      Effect:  Vendors have 2x prices for all services
   0 0 1 1  Minions ravage countryside. All Farmers are now Beggars.
      Effect: City no longer sells food or booze. 
   0 0 0 1  Villain is preparing invasion. All NPCs are ANNOYED.n
      Effect:  All NPCs are GUARD 
   1 1 1 1  Villain has full control. Instead of NPCs spawn D12 Dwellers.
      Effect: All Guards are HOSTILE.
   1 1 1 0  Villain eliminates competitors. You can't sell anything.
      Effect: Instead of 1st Stranger, spawn D20 Boss,
                 which came for you personally.
   1 1 0 1  Villain led minions sacrifice locals. NPC are all BUSY
      Effect: The vanished NPC types now spawn EPIC D12 Dwellers instead.
   1 1 0 0  Villain in power performs sacrifices. NPC are all BUSY
      Effect: Instead of children and beggars, spawn Pursuer Guards.
   1 0 1 1  Mionions infiltrated the government. Loyalists are GUARD.
      Effect: All Guards and Officials spawn Hostile.
   1 0 1 0  Villain's thugs rob shops. Artisans/Merchants are ANNOYED
      Effect: Thugs/Beggars have Brawling if share tile with Merchant/Artisan
   1 0 0 1  Villain led minions kidnap people. NPCs have Loyalist default.
      Effect: Disadvantage to any Talk task.
   1 0 0 0  Villain lures people to nearest forest.
      Effect: Instead of Forager D20 NPC spawn D6 Forest Monster,
                  adding explored tiles count to the roll.

D20 FAMILY
                            For Roll here to see what relatives the hero or NPC has.
                   1. SPOUSE - has wife/husband
                   2. PARENT - has a child
                   3. PROGENY - has father+ mother
                   4. SIBLING - has a broth/sister
                   5-6. SPOUSE+PARENT
                   7-8. SPOUSE+PROGENY
                   9-10. SIBLING+SPOUSE
                   11-12. SIBLING+PARENT
                   13-14. SIBLING+PROGENY
                   15. SPOUSE+PROGENY+PARENT
                  16. SIBLING+SPOUSE+PARENT
                  17. SIBLING+SPOUSE+PROGENY
                  18. SIBLING+SPOUSE+PROGENY+PARENT
                  19-20. NONFAMILIAL - no family
Hero has D20 Family at their home city and they spawn at their family house. Hero has advantage to all tasks against its relatives.
To learn about NPC's family do tough deception investigation task. Knowing about NPC's family gives advantage to intimidation and deception against said NPC. If you have CAPTIVE NPC and know about their family you can gets ransom for that NPC equivalent to NPC's 10x wage - NPC disappears.
Given that hero knows about all NPC's relatives and NPC has no spouse, that hero might attempt to court that NPC to enter romance by doing tough persuasion deception task. The spouse initially joins the heroes, unless dismissed, in which case it can be summoned at that hero's home city and asked to rejoin.
If the hero is a SPOUSE and/or PARENT, and the spouse/children don't travel with the hero, the hero can visit home city, giving the spouse/children 2x their wage to gain 3 FAVOR once a month.
D20 GENDER/ORIENTATION
Roll here to determine character's gender and orientation,
driving sex work (see below) and romantic relationships.
If gender is already known, keep rerolling till roll matches the gender.
                   1-7. Male. Attracted to females. 
                     8-9. Male. Attracted to males and females.
                     10. Male. Attracted to males.
                     11. Female. Attracted to females. 
                     12-13. Female. Attracted to males and females.
                     14-20. Female. Attracted to males. 
RECURRING NPC
When you visit tavern or meet NPC in the wilds, roll d6:
     1-5. Nothing. 6. One of the NPCs is a Recurring NPC.
Each time you spawn them, roll d20 and keep record what you accepted:
1-5. They offer you D20 Legendary Item, telling it will help on your journey.
 6-10. They offer to teach you uncovering your secret D20 Talent.
           Unless you already have 3+ D20 Talents
11-15. They tell D20 Prophecy. If it gets fulfiled, the hero who spoke with
    them gains FULFILED and FAVOR tag.
16-18. If you accepted any of their gifts, roll D6 Global Issue,
    they reveal to serve your enemy:
    * If they gave you legendary item, lose it and gain D20 Torment.
    * If they uncovered your talent, lose it and gain D20 Flaw.
    * If you fulfiled their prophecy, lose FULFILED and gain max DOOM.
    * The Flaw, Torment and the global issue end when you defeat D20
      Dungeon BOSS, behind them. The BOSS will be helped by that NPC.
19-20. They are an actual benefactor. Keep whatever they gave you.
    Roll D6 Global Issue, which ends when you defeat D20 Dungeon BOSS,
    behind it. This NPC offers to join to help with that issue.
If you roll a gift they already gave you, re-roll. If you roll 16-20, but haven't accepted any of their gifts - re-roll. World has single such recurring NPC.

RAID
If at small city, 1 FAVOR to start City adventure, except the monsters spawn from the D12 Dwellers Civilized Biome. If you defeat 20 CR of the monsters, gain 4 INFAMY, PREPARED, 3 RATION, and d20 gp.
D20 INVENTIVE SOLUTION
                            On world map, if have ENGINEER, roll here to   see what
                         solutions exist to help clearing picked area.
     Unless overruled the effect stays active till next Camping. The solution
  costs 3+d20 gp. After solution is greenlit and money paid, advance time by 5 days. Note: the inventive solution for specific area and its price adventure stay the same during single playthrough. 
1. Divert a river to flood the dungeon.  Non swimmer/plant/undead/gadget there die and dungeon tiles are now FLOODED.
2. Poison water/food/air supply (10+d20*5 gp).
   Heroes gain VENOMOUS, and all monsters (besside Undead and Gizmo)
   in the adventure spawn ILL.
3. Collapse. Any monster there with 2 HURT, except undead, gizmo, plants, demons, serpents and spirits.
4. Bribe monsters to betray the BOSS.
   cr1-3 monsters spawn CHARMED, beside undead, gizmo and plants.
5. Bypass route to the BOSS. 1st explored tile is the BOSS tile.
6. Install smoke pumps to blind enemies.
   Monsters, beside undead and plants are Mental while you are BLINDING.
7. Create distraction outside of dungeon.
   For each spawned monster, roll d20: 1-10. It is defeated.
8. Closest city provides d20 guards to clear dungeon (d20*5gp).
   You must success talk with the Lord.
9. Prepare for Terrain. You ignore difficult terrain penalty there.
10. Monitor the dungeon. You know in advance the dungeon layout,
       its monster spawns. Once in dungeon, explore adjacent tiles at will,
       without giving spawned monsters PURSUER.
11. Harm BOSS. BOSS spawns with 4 HURT (non-epic just dies).
12. Wait when the BOSS is away. The boss tile will have no BOSS,
      but will have all the goodies, including KEY.
13-20. No solution.
SPECIAL POWERS
These are assigned based of the characters backstories.
Attack items like WHIP and HANDGUN work as at-will powers.
AMORPHIC: Hero has extra D6 Ability, but all D6 Abilities reroll monthly.
COMPASS: sea travel adventure requires exploring 1/2 less tiles
DRAGONSLAYER: spend daily power to use hero's at-will power to kill any REPTILE on a successful hit. Note: Kobolds are considered dragons.
ENTREPRENEUR: You gain double profit from goods delivery, smuggle,
and business (see Real Estate). You also have Advantage to Persuasion.
ESTATE: you get d20 gp at start of each month.
HANDGUN: A glock pistol and 6 BULLETs (+4 to-hit, 4 HURT).
HOVERBOARD: can get back the moment you enter elevation/flooded tile,  
KATANA: Before your melee attack, you can decide to use katana.
On hit the target dies. On miss the katana breaks.
Each time you discover new city, roll d4: 1-2. can buy new katana (8gp).
MOTION_TRACKER: Can explore tile without visiting and spawned monsters are non-PURSUERS.
PSION: specify D and roll d6: on a roll of D or above, the target suffers hit based of D: 1-2. MEEK. 2-3. PUNY; 3. CHARMED. 4. NORMAL; 5. STRONG;  Of failure you gain TIRED. Target's ally PSION, can get TIRED instead of target's HURT. AI uses d6 to pick D. To psion a Task, have its skill training.
RAGESTRIKE: Gain HURT to attack 3 times.
VAMPIRE: For every kill, lose HURT. At the start of every night you lose all HURT and TIRED. At night / indoor / Umbrath, gain +1 to rolls + UNDEAD, but Disadvantage at day. Kill NPC once a month or lose level + DOOM.
WEREWOLF: When begin night adventure, do REAL task to stop becoming werewolf: agile tough strong quick, healing, but dumb and crazy.
WHIP:  you have HUNTER and your hit gives target BOUND. 
SOULBINDER: gain tags of killed foe till another kill or the next camping.
TALENTED: you can spend FAVOR to gain INFORMED.
TIMEUNWIND: Instead of losing an adventure, just return to world map with all the heroes at full health, and MENTAL/BOUND/ILL removed.
After use, do EASY task to avoid losing this ability forever.
SCOUT: do Investigation task to see adjacent room contents. INFORMED SCOUT can do EASY Investigation instead. Scout can also spend 10 XP to see adjacent area's biome+ways without exploring the tiles.

WILDS FORAGERS
d4 Forager D20 NPCs with Odd default mood. All are PURSUERs.
* If you kill them, the last one escapes (if succeeds, gain INFAMY).
* These NPCs will move towards any animal and attack it.
* If they kill animal, they take its PELTs and the RATION part.
* If night when 5+ tiles are explored / you hit one / have SEEING,
  roll d20: 1-5 they turn into were- d3: 1.wolf, 2.boar, 3.bear
Note: on sea biome they instead turn into were-d3: 1. Shark, 2. Crab, 3. Ray

UMBRATH ADVENTURE
                           Accessed by Gate spell, or by traveling though Netherelm
                      tiles. Umbrath plane has the layout and the Biomes of the
    related material plane area, yet all monsters are HIDING, while any
  canine/feline, dragon and giant get replaced with Shadow Mastiff, Shadow
 Dragon, and Death Giant.
Shadow Mastiff cr2 hiding hunter binder butcher beast.
Young Shadow Dragon cr5 epic hiding hard toxic blaster plague reptile.
Death Giant cr6 epic strong hard ranged agile hiding dementer bane giant
FINDING FAMILIAR
Mages can do taming task to make cr1 Mephit their familiar (one familiar at time),  Can Druids do same with Beasts, Clerics - with Spirits.
INFORMED hero can also tame cr2 familiars.
Familiar is a permanent ally. If familiar dies, you gain 1 HURT.
You can pickup the familiar in your inventory (counts toward item limit), which prevents it from being harmed. A hero can possess their familiar,
which moves the familiar instead of hero, while hero can't act, and familiar can do any task, hero can do. Unpossessing familiar takes familiar's action.
SHIP OWNERSHIP
This section concerns with owning your own ship as
opposed to leasing one. OWNSHIP here prevents you from losing
SHIP when enter a city.
RAFT
Stranded on an island? - Spend 5 XP, do REAL Survival, then do REAL Navigation to gain SHIP, but lose PREPARED and all items/gp.
HIJACKING A SHIP
This is available when you are at Sea area and have SHIP, but without OWNSHIP. Gain 6 INFAMY if you start this adventure. The hijack ship adventure proceeds like normal sea adventure, except the monsters spawn from the D12 Dwellers Civilized Biome. If you defeat 20 CR of the monsters, the adventure ends and you gain OWNSHIP, which prevents you from losing the SHIP when you enter a city.
SHIP DAMAGE
OWNSHIP has associated DAMAGE, starting at 0. If damage reaches 5, the ship sinks (lose OWNSHIP), and you must move the party to the closest port city. Losing sea adventure increases the DAMAGE by 1. Damage can be lost at any port for 10gp.
PIRACY
If at sea, spend 1 FAVOR to start Sea adventure, except the monsters spawn from the D12 Dwellers Civilized Biome. If you defeat 20 CR of the monsters, the adventure ends and you to 20 + d20*2 gp and gain 4 INFAMY.
AIRSHIP
If you have OWNSHIP, sacrifice Legendary Item and cast either Alter, Weather Control or Wish to turn it into an airship.
Travel adventure requires exploring 1/2 less tiles.

NEMESIS MONSTERS
If hero with DOOM defeats a monster on odd roll, and has no NEMESIS, this monster becomes a nemesis monster. Now each time hero rolls natural 1 and has DOOM, spawn nemesis with NEMESIS+EPIC tags. 

D20 LEGENDARY ITEM
Roll D6 Item Type.  After that determine who can use it.
Roll d4 three separate times - each roll of 1 adds a restriction:
* only a specific D8 Race can use it;
* usable only by chaotic/neutral/lawful (roll D20 Map);
* the item is Sentient (see Prop at Special NPC section).
If you already have/had an item with such adjective, reroll it, but this time with additional D20 Accessory Adjective, if again you had such adjective, take 20+d20 gp instead. Each such item costs 40 + d20 gp.
D6 ITEM TYPE
Hero can have only a single specific d6 item type equipped at time.
1. Melee Weapon: +2 to-hit magic weapon. Roll D12 Weapon Adjective.
   Roll D6 Class: if FIGHTER/CLERIC, then only this class can use it.
2. Ranged Weapon with d3 range. Roll D12 Weapon Adjective.
   Roll D6 Class: if FIGHTER/ROGUE, then only this class can use it.
3. Consumable. Roll D12 Consumable. If d4 is 1/2, only MAGE can use it
4. Armor: Roll D6 Armor Adjective
   Roll D6 Class: if FIGHTER/CLERIC, then only this class can use it.
5. Accessory. Roll D20 Accessory Adjective
   If d4 is 1 or 2, then only MAGE can use it.
6. Key: Roll D6 Key Item
D6 KEY ITEM
1-2. Eldath Scrolls. Mandatory prerequisite for casting Epic Spells.
3-4. Codex of the Pale Eclipse: describes spells/rituals to become Lich,
  Death Knight, Vampire, Werewolf, Voidlich, etc..
5-6. Umbral Seed. Consumed to move a area to Umbrath. See Planar Rift
epic spell. You gain control over any SMALL city on that area.

                                         D20 ACCESSORY ADJECTIVE
                               1. Protective. -2 to attack rolls of D20 Monster Type
                         2. Freedom. Immune to KICKER and BOUND
                     3. Haste. +2 to-speed
    4. All-Purpose. Get +2 to any task.
 5. D6 Class Utility. Random Utility Power of a specific class, but any class
    can equip this item.
6. Mind. Advantage on all non at-will attacks, and spells.
7. D20 Skill Manual. Advantage on using said skill.
8. Invisibility. Gains HIDDEN against cr1-3 monsters.
9. Evasion. +1 AC
10. Sending. Wearer has SENDER.
11. Immunity. d4: 1. MENTAL;  2. FIRE;  3. WATER;  4. ACID/CAUSTIC.
12. Conjuration. Summon D12 Dwellers monster till next Camping. Recharges on camping.
13. Holding. Store any number of items. Take out one item per day.
14. D20 Skill Proficiency. Sets that skill 15, if it is below.
15. Clockwork. Once/day, change a dice roll this hero does to 20.
16. Chronomaster. Once a day cast Time Stop ritual spell.
17. Pocket Stronghold. Use to place a Stronghold (see Real Estate) at
    current area. Further uses move it to a new area.
18. Creation. Once a day creates D20 Mundane Item.
19. Scholar's. -2 to XP to level up.
20. Vigor. Wearer is TOUGH and immune to ILL.
BASIC EQUIPMENT
If you roll 1 on attack or foe rolls 20 attacking you, gain WORN.
Each time your WORN gets over 3, lose all WORN and check current d20:
* Odd and your weapon is non-magic/legendary, gain UNARMED;
  UNARMED hero can't spend XP to modify attack roll.
* Even and your armor is non-magic/legendary, gain UNARMORED.
  UNARMORED hero  can't spend XP to modify foe's attack roll.
If got UNARMED/UNARMORED already having it, gain 3 WORN + 1 HURT.
You can pay 2 gp to vending mood Blacksmith to lose all WORN (Repair).  Smith Tools, Mending cantrip - too remove WORN.
If have POLISH, lose POLISH instead of basic weapon/armor.
if hero defeats a humanoid entity with roll 20 hit, the hero loses UNARMED
  and UNARMORED - found appropriate equipment.
D6 ARMOR ADJECTIVE
1. Adamantine. +3 to AC, immunity to critical hits.
     Can't use ROGUE and MAGE's utility/daily powers.
2. Mithral. +2 to AC.
3. Winged. Wearer has FLYER condition 
4. Archmage's. +1 to AC, +2 to number of equippable powers.
5-6. Roll D20 Accessory Adjective instead
D12 WEAPON ADJECTIVE
1. Bane. 2x HURT Against D20 Monster Type
2. Vorpal. On a melee roll of 18+, a target with a single head dies.
3. D20 Skill Master. If trained skill, Advantage on task with that skill.
4. Oath. Gain 4x the XP when D20 Monster Type spawns Once per day,
   hero can change picked monster type.
5. Vampiric. You're VAMPIRIC while have this weapon.
6. Equalizer. Foes lose strong/puny/tough/frail tags.
7. Avenger. 2x damage against evil D20 Map Alignment.
8. Force. On hit target of hero size or below is moved 1 tile away.
9. Champion. If you kill with 19+ roll, gain FAVOR.
10. Martyr's. Gain 1 HURT to deal 3x the HURT.
11. Bloodthirsty. On hit, deal extra HURT for each HURT the wielder has.
12. Doom. Extra HURT for each DOOM the wielder has.
D12 CONSUMABLE
1. Wand. d10 charges of D20 Common Mage Spell
   If d4 is 1-2, only MAGE can use it.
2. Symbol. d10 charges of D20 Common Cleric Spell
   If d4 is 1-2, only CLERIC can use it.
3. Tablet. d4 uses of a D20 Ritual Spell
   Roll D6 Class: if MAGE/CLERIC, then only this class can use it.
4. Ambrosia. Using it gives you ESSENCE.
5. Panacea. Removes all HURT, MENTAL, ILL, BOUND and INFESTED.
6. D20 Map / Alignment Purger. d8 charges, 10 to hit, kills any creature of that alignment, if it has 1+ HURT. Determines unknown alignment on hit.
7. Hermetic Tome. Mage can Learn additional ritual spell.
8. Eye of Allseer. The hero who consumed it gains SEEING.
9. Elixir. The actor who consumed it can't be ILL.
10. Overmind's Brainstem. The hero who consumed it can't be MENTAL.
11. Relic. Single charge of a D20 Epic Spell
12. Providence Potion. Consumer loses 3 DOOM + gains 3 FAVOR.
