FIVE ROOM DUNGEON
                            Such dungeon is persistent and has just 5 rooms,
                      arranged as...
                         1. D8 Entrance, leads to Passage A and Passage B
                         2. D10 Passage A. Leads to D8 Hall 
                         3. D10 Passage B. Leads to D8 Hall 
                         4. D8 Hall. Leads to D20 Treasury
                         5. D20 Treasury, may hold something of interest to you.
                     Each ROOM has challenge blocking exit to the next room.
D8 ENTRANCE
1. d6 monsters from from the D12 Dwellers
2. D20 Boss guarding the entrance.
3. HARD Task required to enter. Can be attempted once a month.
4. Requires a KEY from the next dungeon to enter.
5. Need hero/NPC with with specific trained D20 Skill to proceed.
6. To enter, talk first to NPC, trackable at previous city. Succeed talk task.
7. To enter, have specific D20 Mundane Item worth at least d10 gp 
8. Spend 1 FAVOR.
D8 PASSAGE A/B
Upon entering the room, roll into D12 Trick below
1. d8 monsters from from the D12 Dwellers
2. Do HARD Task to avoid D6 Entrance condition blocking exit to Hall.
3. Needs D20 NPC type to unlock exit to Hall.
4. Needs a hero or NPC with any of 5 D20 Virtue to proceed
5. Needs a hero or NPC with any of 5 D20 Flaw to proceed
6. Only those with 2 FAVOR can proceed
7. Only those with 3 DOOM can proceed
8. The door to D6 Hall is locked from inside. See Locked Doors and Traps.
D8 HALL
1. Do HARD task to defeat D20 Boss.
2. Do HARD task to unlock exit to D20 Treasury.
3. Needs 10 XP to unlock exit to D20 Treasury.
4. Spawn 2x D6 Biome monsters with +15 to roll.
5. Need casting Wish or Gate to proceed.
6. Need a FULFILED hero to proceed.
7. Only a hero who has any D20 Legendary Item can enter.
8. Oracle demands D20 Prophecy to come true in a month.
     Or the D20 Treasury is locked permanently.
D12 TRICK
1. If stay here for 5+ turns the adventure is lost.
2. Door closes behind you. Do HARDAthletics to open it.
3. Too small. Only SMALL entities can pass the exit to Hall.
4. Exit to Hall is Elevated.
5. Do HARD task to avoid spawning d8 monsters.
6. Place two D20 Prop. Both accessible from this room.
7. Each round you spend here, gain 1 DOOM or lose 1 FAVOR
8. Each round you spend here, gain HURT
9. Exit to hall needs Shape Water cast or a FLYER or SWIMMER hero/NPC.
10. Any hero who enters gains 2 HURT
11. Any hero who enters gains MENTAL+ILL+BOUND.
12. Each round here spends here spawns a monster.
D20 TREASURY
1-2. Roll d20: 1-10. D20 Legendary Item; 11-20. d20 * 6gp
3. Roll d20,
   1-10. Scroll teaching D20 Ritual Spell
   11-20. Cursed D20 Legendary Item (D20 Torment while you carry it)
4. 1st entering hero is awarded by ESSENCE for freeing a deity.
5-16. This roll multiplied by 5gp.
17. D6 NPCs held captive, without gp or wares.
   Each of these NPCs moves to a previously visited city,
   Once home, each will reward you with 2x their salary.
   If any of them is a Noble, gain PATRON at their city.
18. 2x D20 Treasure + 20.
19. This place can be used as a Stronghold (see Real Estate).
20. Place of redemption. Each time you visit it, lose all DOOM tags.

VOIDFARING
                            To obtain a voidfarer vessel, either have OWNSHIP and
                   cast Voidsail epic spell on it, or cast Gate ritual spell to appear
   at the LARGE city of Starhaven, where such ship can be traded for 3
  legendary items.
Once you've a voidfarer vessel, as a daily action do REAL Arcana task to take off from the surface of Nymara or Starhaven into The Void. In The Void, do Arcana task to disembark again at any Nymara area or Starhaven. If you roll 1-2 while failing the task, voidfare crash-lands.
Fixing crashlanded voidfarer requires paying 20gp to a Merchant NPC at a LARGE city for spare voidfarer parts.
If you disembark at or adjacent to a city on Nymara, without having a PATRON there, your voidfarer will be confiscated.
At Starhaven you can board a voidfarer taxi (10gp) which can disembark you like a voidfarer you own. You can as well attempt to hijack it.
The rules are same as for hijacking a ship, except foes are all EPIC.
YOU ARE VICTORIOUS!
Read this section when heroes have 10 FULFILED tags.
  "You are victorious! The heroes have accomplished their goals."
Don't forget to record the Gallantry Points and the number of days it took to
complete the campaign, as well as the achievements:
DEITY: win the game on HONORABLE IMPOSSIBLE
DEMIGOD: win the game on IMPOSSIBLE. 
HONORABLE_READY: win the game without having a single RECKLESS tag.
NORMIE: win the game without any Special Powers.
RICH: win the game with 400 gp.
SOLOIST: win the game with a single hero.
GAMEOVER: If the party has too many MONTHs, the game is lost:
   * On PRACTICE gain GAMEOVER upon getting 60 MONTH tags.
   * On NORMAL gain GAMEOVER upon getting 40 MONTH tags.
   * On DIFFICULT gain GAMEOVER upon getting 30 MONTH tags.
   * On IMPOSSIBLE gain GAMEOVER upon getting 20 MONTH tags.
 If GAMEOVER, read: "All is lost. The heroes couldn't fulfill their destinies."
AMULET OF YENDOR (read if got one)
      "Beware! Mortals shouldn't be toying with this item.
       It doesn't belong to Nymara..." - Mentor
Now you can surrender the amulet to Mentor and stop reading this section.
Rumored to be the key to godhood, the amulet has alignment, identifiable at a large city for 4gp, just like the Hero's one. When identified, the amulet can be used as an once per camping power based of amulet/hero alignment:
* Evil: if hero is EVIL, kill any GOOD non-EPIC foe wearing hero hits,
* Neutral: gives all neutral heroes Phased.
* Good: fully heal the good heroes.
Flip off the amulet after use, and on Camping face up again.
A Hero can instantly gain FULFILED if that hero sacrifices the amulet at
the altar of the god matching the Hero's alignment, located at:
* Good: the next explored LARGE city.
* Neutral: the next explored Sea area.
* Evil:  the next explored Netherelm area.
After 1st time using the amulet, using hero gains D20 Torment / 12. Tiamat.
Tiamat, seeking the lost trinket from her hoard and now knows about you.
Maybe you should have surrendered that amulet to Mentor?...
TARRASQUE
Nymara's most dreaded monster awakens once a century,
Spawns at any city entrance, attacking heroes and NPCs.
Tarrasque cr9 epic strong tough slow absurd ranged vorous binder
                 2surge healing toxic venomous blaster army beast
* Loot: two D20 Legendary Items and ESSENCE
DIFFICULTY OPTIONS
The difficulty limits the time you have to gain FULFILED.
* PRACTICE: the heroes are almost guaranteed to win.
* NORMAL: with some effort you can win on their 1st attempt.
* DIFFICULT: start with 3 DOOM.
* IMPOSSIBLE: heroes start with INFAMY, DOOM,  and D20 Torment.
Optional difficulty tags:
* MOTIVATED: exploration spawned monsters have D20 Motivation
* SCARRED: rules from the D6 Disability section are active.
* IDENT: enables mechanics from the Item Identification section.
* HONORABLE: If all heroes gain COMA, gain GAMEOVER
D20 COMMON SPELL
                          Mage learns common spells from scholar NPCs, but level N
                    cleric gets N random D20 Cleric Spells.
  To cast common spell at any moment, spend 6XP (4XP if INFORMED).
  Unless overruled, effects, including summons, persist till Camping.
 The (N Skill) defines how much HURT it deals to task entity. 
D20 CLERIC SPELL
1. Animal Bond (2 Taming): roll d20 if cast at animal:
   1-5 nothing; 6-15 it is defeated; 16-20 - it joins till the end of adventure.
2. Divination (2 Religion): Explore adjacent tiles, spawning no-monsters.
3. Cause Fear (2 Intimidation): you gain SCARY, CR 1-4 target - MENTAL
4. Create Food (1 Taming): Gain RATION.
5. Commune with Nature (2 Nature): 2x XP from exploring/spawn.
6. Destroy Undead: defeat CR 1-4 undead.
7. Entangling Vines: Foes gain BOUND, you gain - HUNTER.
8. Freedom of Movement:  Target gains FREE.
9. Fox Cunning (1 Arcana/History/Survival): Reroll spawned monsters.
10. Guidance. Task becomes FRAIL, while monster loses TOUGH.
11. Hold Person (1 Intimidation): cr1-4 foe is BOUND, you're PARALYZER
12. Meld into Environment (1 Stealth): Move all foes to picked exit.
13. Legend Lore (2 History): Identify all items.
     Replace each trinket with D20 Treasure.
14. Restoration(2 Medicine): you and allies lose ILL.
15. Regenerate: target gains HEALING.
16. Empowerment: heroes hits to monsters/tasks are STRONG, till leave tile.
17. Divine Voice (2 Performance): target gains MENTAL, you gain SHOCKER.
18. Weather Control (2 Survival): Specific monster (E.g. all kobolds) won't
       spawn till next camping.
19. True Seeing (2 Perception): target gains SEEING
20. Zone of Truth (2 Insight): you and allies lose MENTAL.



D20 MAGE SPELL
1. Alter (1 Athletics/Perception/Survival): target is Swimmer+Climber
2. Banish: cr1-4 SPIRIT disappears.
3. Arcane Hand (do EASY to +10 Athletics/Intimidation/Performance):
   Summons Arcane Hand ally on your tile.
4. Charm Person (2 Persuasion): cr1-4 target gains CALM.
5. Counterspell (1 Arcana): Target gains NULLIFIER.
6. Detect Magic (2 Arcana): Target gains LUCID.
7. Mindread( 1 Deception/Persuasion/Intimidation): Target gains GAWKY.
8. Disguise (2 Deception): Target gains DISGUISED.
9. Fly (1 Acrobatics): Target gains FLYER.
10. Haste (2 Acrobatics/Performance): Target gains FAST..
11. Invisibility (2 Stealth): Target gains HIDING.
12. Floating Leap (2 Acrobatics): Get through elevated/chasm exit.
13. Sanctuary: target gains BOUND, you gain SHELTER.
14. Phantom Steed: summons Phantom Steed mount ally (See Mounting).
15. Ray of Sickness: All foes are ILL and you gain VENOMOUS.
16. Enlarge/Reduce (2 Athletics): ally target becomes STRONG, foe - PUNY
17. Misty Step (1 Stealth): caster escape to picked exit.
18. Sending. Target gains SENDER can act on your ally's tile.
19. Telekinesis  (2 Sleight/Acrobatics): gain KICKER+PROTECTOR
20. Summon. Lose SURGE and spawn a D12 Dwellers monster as ally.

D20 MOTIVATION
                           Hero can talk to a motivated monster (see Monster Talk).
                     Such monsters start with respective Tags.
   Beasts always have 11. Hungry motivation, unless you rolled 7-17.
 Spirits always have 12. Gizmos always have 13. Undead always have 14. 
1. Dweller. GUARD HUNTER TRAPPER.
    Talk (Persuasion): gains CALM (CHARMED if INFORMED hero)
2. Assassins. Tags:  DISGUISED HUNTER BINDER
    Talk (Persuasion):  disappear if you pay CR amount of gp,
3. Insane. MENTAL. Talk (cure MENTAL): becomes 8. Lost.
4. Fanatics. EXPLOSIVE. Talk (Deception): gains TIMED CALM
5. Patrol. ESCAPER. Talk (Deception): TIMED CALM +lose ESCAPER
6. Thieves. COWARD THIEF. Talk (give 2gp or any item): disappear.
7. Probing. COWARD BUTCHER. Talk (Intimidation): disappear.
8. Lost. GUARD. Talk (Persuasion):  CALM PURSUER.
9. Hunter. HIDDEN HUNTER TRAPPER.  Talk (Intimidation): disappear
10. Guardians. GUARD. Talk (Deception):  CALM.
11. Hungry. RAGER BUTCHER. Talk (lose RATION): disappear.
12. Summoned. SPIRIT. Talk (Arcana / Banish cast): disappear.
13. Mindless GIZMO. Talk (Investigation): CHARMED.
14. Mindless UNDEAD. Talk (Arcana/Religion): CHARMED.
15. Prisoners. BOUND CALM. Talk (lose BOUND): CHARMED.
16. Mimics. DISGUISED. Talk(hurt/got seeing): replace with other monster.
17. Seeks revenge. NEMESIS. Talk (Persuasion): CALM.
18. Seeks worthy foe. CHAMPION. Talk (Deception): disappear.
19. Sentry. SPAWNER. Talk (Deception): CALM
20. Performing a ritual. ARCHMAGE. 
        Talk (Arcana/Performance/Lore): they gain max TIRED.
PSION at 3 can instead of damage re-roll the motivation. Wish spell or PSION at 6 allow you to pick any motivation.
MONSTER TALK
Any Forager NPC can teach you monster language (4gp). D20 Motivation has Talk options. To talk do REAL task with list D20 Skill. If you don't know monster language then the task has Disadvantage. If monster is BOSS, then the task is HARD. Note: goblin hero by default has no Disadvantage and with language training has Advantage.
D20 CANTRIP
On camping Lv N MAGE gets N random cantrips, usable
by spending FOCUS and gaining 1 TIRED, as at-will powers.
The (N Skill) is the HURT dealt to task, when used at a task.
 Unless overruled, the effect lasts till heroes leave tile.
1. Chill Touch: gain WATER SLOWER BINDER HUNTER
2. Create Bonfire (1 Survival). Each hero gains FIRE and all tiles around
     lose DARK and get explored. Heroes can rest here for 1 XP.
3. Dancing Lights (1 Performance/Deception).
    Summon cr0 MEEK FRAIL decoy ally
4. Eldritch Blast[R]. Spend FOCUS to inflict HURT
    You don't lose remaining FOCUS tags. See Ritual Spells.
5. Friends (3 Persuasion, NPCs on tile gain ANNOYED). Target is MENTAL.
6. Gust (1 Deception). TINY/SMALL foes gain GAWKY.
7. Light. Caster gains FIRE till next camping.
8. Mending (1 Investigation). Target loses 1 WORN (+ 2 HURT if Gizmo).
9. Message (1 Stealth/Deception if ally on tile). Gain LEADER+GAWKY.
10. Minor Illusion. Target gains MENTAL, you - CONFUSER.
11. Prestidigitation (1 Deception/Performance/Sleight). Target is SLOW
12. Ray of Frost[R]:  +4 to-hit, 2 HURT, WATER hit
13. Resistance. Gain HAZARD and GAWKY.
14. Ward. If good gain WARD_EVIL, if evil gain WARD_GOOD, else - both.
15. Shape Water (1 Deception). Remove Flooded from exits+gain WATER.
16. Shocking Grasp. Gain SHOCKER DEMENTER
17. Spare the Dying.  Target loses COMA.
18. Thaumaturgy (1 Intimidation/Religion/Deception). Gain 5 FOCUS
19. Toll the Dead. Gain BUTCHER.
20. True Strike. gain HUNTER+BINDER.

D20 RITUAL SPELLS
                            Mage can learn ritual spell from a specific Scholar.
                  Cleric learns random ritual spell each time it gains FULFILED.
     In addition, any cleric knows Resurrection spell.
Casting D20 Ritual Spell at a city without PATRON makes all guards hostile.
To cast such ritual spell, a FULFILED PREPARED INFORMED Cleric/Mage knowing this spell must spend R FOCUS, lose 1 FAVOR, gain 1 HURT.
R is the FOCUS you had while casting this spell. For AI casters, R is their HURT count + 1. A NULLIFIER targeted by D20 Ritual can spend R XP to evade its effect. For hero, R can't be above hero's level.
Unless overruled, the effect lasts till next camping. AI caster = monster.
0. Resurrection (cleric only). Gain 5 SURGEs.
   A cleric eligible to cast Resurrection, can use SURGE at Sarcophagus prop
   to resurrect a dead hero as Adventurer NPC.
1. None. You don't cast / learn any spell.
2. Absolute Immunity. * If monster: Cast on itself. Else, Target gains
    R INDOMITABLE tags.
3. Greater Scry. * If AI caster: Explores R tiles, spawning monsters. Else,
  Gain R*5 XP and explore R dungeon tiles, without entering them.
  Spawned monsters have no PURSUER.
4. Antimagic Field. You and R-1 allies gain NULLIFIER till next Camping.
5. Dominate. Gain DREAD CHARMER, while a CR<=R foes are MENTAL.
6. Lifeblend. If the CR of non-Undead/Gadget is below R, they merge into Aberrant has the tags of each. Roll: 1-5 - hostile; 6-20 - it is ally.
7. Astral Projections. Move backrow, gain BOUND+MENTAL and spawn R projections of you. They acts as a hero, but die any hit with roll 11+. If projection dies, owner gains HURT. While any projection is alive you're IMMOBILE. You can dismiss the all at once projections at-will, and if done at the owner's tile, owner loses MENTAL+BOUND. Projections can hit PHASED foes without spending XP.
8. Demiplane. Pick tile's side and open/replace exit to the demiplane tile,
   persistent and unique for each caster. Move all actors and items from
   current tile there - they persist visits.
    * Caster can banish upto R foes from the demiplane.
    * This exit replace any other exit from/to this demiplane.
    * The caster can add/remove CHASM to the exit from the demiplane.
    * If AI caster: banishes all but the weakest foe from Deminplane.
           9. Clone. At end of next R campings, you will gain CLONE.
               10. Curse.  R foes gain MENTAL+ILL+BOUND+3 DOOM.
                     11. Soulrend. Kills R targets whose CR is at/below R.
12. Foresight. Allies gain SEER, SEEING, INFORMED
                         on next R campings.
13. Gate. Pick one:
    * Summon ally monsters of total CR <= R.
    * Kill/Banish all Demon/Spirit foes, if total CR <= R.
    * Teleport to any visited city or to Starhaven.
    * If AI caster: summons monsters.
14. Summon Radiant Sphere cr6 puny epic phased warper weakener
                                                  anomalous dying spirit.
* Sphere gains R INDOMITABLE tags.
* Monster's AI prioritizes attacking heroes.
15. Reverse Gravity. Allies gain Flyer for next R Campings. Foes lose Flyer.
16. Soul Cage. Target with CR <= R falls into COMA, while you get a soul
  gem. Now by spending its CR XP, you can use this soul gem to spawn
  target as an Undead ally. If target uses 2 SURGEs, you lose the soul gem.
17. Time Stop. All but caster can't act for R rounds.
18. True Polymorph. Target with CR < R gets turned for R days into a monster you seen before. If AI caster: random  current biome monster.
19. Weird. Allies gain SCARY, while CR <= R foes gain MENTAL. 
20. Wish. Roll d20 and if it is at/below R, you pick wish (else d20 picks).
  WISE caster can spend R XP to subtract R from this roll.
  CRAZY caster needs 9 FOCUS to cast Wish and roll is always random.
    1. R targets lose all HURT and TIRED, as well as MENTAL, ILL, BOUND.
    2. R targets gain 3 HURT.
    3. Teleport heroes to an explored world map area of their choice.
    4. Cast any other D20 Ritual Spell
    5. Gain R*20 gp.
    6. Gain R D20 Treasures
    7. Gain D20 Legendary item
    8. Recharge all powers and items.
    9. Gain ESSENCE.
  10. Gain permanent FLYER.
  11. Lose all DOOM and gain 3 FAVOR.
  12. Gain permanent HEALING (R must be 9).
  13. Gain permanent HIDING (R must be 9).
  14. Gain R powers of any classes.
  15. Banish monsters whose total CR is below R.
  16. Get training in R skills.
  17. Gain any D6 Ability.
  18. Lose any D6 Lapse.
  19. Gain permanent NULLIFIER.
  20. Gain PISON and SEEING.
PLAYING DRAGON
                           Generate dragon as usual hero, without a race.
                    Instead of D20 Bond, you roll D5 Dragon Type. Begin as a
   wyrmling and upon reaching Lv.3 gain EPIC, becoming young. Once FULFILED, you're adult dragon and can re-roll once a day the roll which will otherwise kill you.
Dragon has access to additional daily powers:
* Dragon Breath (young/adult) all on tile: +3 to-hit, your strength hit.
   Depending on dragon type, it also inflicts MENTAL, BOUND or ILL.
   Adult dragon can gain TIRED to recharge breath..
* Fly (young/adult). Gain TIRED to gain FLYER till you leave the tile.
* Wing Buffet (adult only). Move all but one opponents to other tiles.
* Human Form. Morph into a human. Lasts for the rest of the day,
  or until you cancel it. You don't have access to your dragon powers
  and lose EPIC.
Dragon has no penalty without weapon/armor, which it can wear only in human form.
If dragon visits a city not in a human form, all NPCs will be Hostile. You can hire only evil NPCs as a dragon. Red dragon can create lair in a city, which requires first murdering its lord. The dragon will then be considered the new city lord.
As a dragon, you can build 1 stronghold, called "lair", at your biome's area. That will cost you 80gp. At your lair, you're INFORMED and EPIC.
Unless wyrmling, in your lair, you can lay egg (20gp), which in a month hatches into a wyrmling, which is basically an additional life for you. I.e., if you have wyrmling, you don't lose anything on defeat, beside 1 of your wyrmlings. You can bring only 1 of your wyrmlings - rest stays at your lair.
You can have up to 10 wyrmlings at your lair.
While the egg is unhatched, on days 5, 10, 15 and 20 you have to roll for D12 Dwellers monster, whose total CR is equivalent to month's day.


D5 DRAGON TYPE
Gain FULFILED upon completing the associated goal.
All dragons are considered flying mounts: DC3 1st travel this day.
1. Blue. +2 to any roll in desert. You're SHOCKER. Your breath inflicts MENTAL.
   Every day your wyrmling kills NPC, it lose 3 HURT and you lose DOOM.
   Goal: Produce 10 Wyrmlings. Ensure each participates in a battle against
             a cr5+ monster, which should be defeated there.
2. Green. +2 to any roll in forest. Your breath is ILL. You're VENOMOUS.
   You get PREPARED for killing 3 NPCs on a single day.
   You can enter water without penalty.
   Goal: Recruit 100XP army of monsters.
3. Red. +2 to any roll in mountains and Netherelm.
   You are SCARY and your breath inflicts MENTAL.
   The 1st time you kill the lord at each city, you get 5x its gp.
   Fire-resistant: immune to flammable tiles, reroll once any fire..
   Goal: Amass 1000 gp.
4. Black. +2 to any roll in swamp and plains. Your breath is MENTAL.
   You're CONFUSER. You get FAVOR for killing 10 NPCs on a single day.
   Can enter elevated tiles without penalty or DC.
   Goal: Become a lich. You know D20 Area having Five Room Dungeon,
             holding Codex of the Pale Eclipse in the final room.
5. White. +2 to any roll in snow/tundra. Your breath inflicts BOUND.
   You're HUNTER. You get RATION for killing 3 NPCs on a single day.
   Can travel over sea without a SHIP.
   Goal: Kill 2x of each biome's giant type.


EPIC SCALE RULES
                           This chapter involves city and army management, as well as
                      some more powerful hero abilities.
  SHADOWEAVE
 A hero who has Umbral Seed can cast Astral Projection to gain SHADOWEAVER - an ability to cast Epic Spells.
LICH TRANSFORMATION
A FULFILED hero can become a Lich who is Undead and immune to Aged. Obtain a copy of  Codex of the Pale Eclipse, either accidentally or by casting Greater Scry (The dungeon there has 20 XP of monsters, and a Voidlich at the end has the book). Once you possess it, at a LARGE city buy a Phylactery vessel (40gp). Now either hero or ally must cast Soul Cage on the hero, who gains LICH, also getting a FULFILED tag.
VOIDLICH TRANSFORMATION
A SHADOWEAVER LICH can gain VOIDLICH by casting Demiplane on it. 
REAL ESTATE
Hero can own businesses, strongholds and even cities.
BUSINESS: Establish at a city with a PATRON by paying 60gp to an official NPC in Vending mood. Income is 5gp for a small city, 10gp/month - medium city, 15gp - large city. 1 business per city. You get 2x the gp from a city you own.
STRONGHOLD: Establish (100gp) at a D20 Dungeon with a defeated BOSS. Stronghold allows you to recruit and control armies (see Armies).
CITY: A city you control brings you income:  5gp for SMALL city, 20gp for MEDIUM, and 40gp for LARGE. A large city also serves a stronghold. Player can capture city through starting a city adventure, where street tiles spawn D12 Dwellers Civilized monsters each with ARMY tag, and defeating N CR of them where N equals city's income gp.
ARMIES
Army is a normal monster with an ARMY tag.
Some monsters, like Tarrasque, are single-unit armies.
If you are at stronghold you can recruit a new army, which joins as a hero.
To recruit, do REAL History task and pay its CR*30 gp.
By default you can recruit only militia:
   Militia cr2 puny frail slow human army
If you possess Eldath Scrolls, you can also do HARD Arcana to hire mages.
   Mage cr3 ranged puny frail ranged caster human army
Heroes can't have more CR of armies than their max surges.
ARMY has monthly gp upkeep equal 2x its CR.
If you have an ARMY, you can plunder gp from the current city equal to its income (once a month), but that immediately spawns enemy armies. 
Upon plundering gain 2 INFAMY tags.
ENEMY ARMIES
Given that you control N cities, Every MONTH, CR N of D12 Dweller Civilized ARMYs will add to your daily chase. With less than 3 INFAMY, the heroes can do HARD History to discard currently chasing armies (sign truce). If you lose an adventure while on tile with these armies, lose all your captured cities
ABANDONMENT
As a world map action, a Hero may leave. Chaotic Evil/Neutral
hero will also attempt to rob the party REAL (Advantage if ROGUE):
Pass:  steal all the gold and items this hero can carry.
Fail: you got caught, losing all its gold and items.
In all cases, you get all the FULFILED tags, move to adjacent area
and can now proceed solo or gather other party. Abandoned party
can track such hero by HARD Survival or by paying Fence/Smuggler 30gp.
Do HARD Survival to track and fight this hero.

EPIC SPELLS
                           A GOD (or a FULFILED MAGE with Eldath Scrolls) can
                    learn random epic spell (100gp) from the Magic Guild scholar
    at a LARGE city by spending 5 LORE. Casting epic spell requires
  spending D20 Legendary Item or spending 3 FAVOR or spending 3 levels.
1. Power Binding. You can now cast epic spells by spending 40gp instead of sacrificing a legendary item.
2. Planar Rift. Turn area into Umbrath, and Umbrath area into a normal area. Alternately open permanent path to another plane: the current area will have an open gate to this plane's start area.
3. Epic Dominate. Gain control over the target city. But you lose 1 level for SMALL city, 2 - for MEDIUM, and 4 for LARGE. If not enough levels, dominate fails.
4. Epic Gate. Summon a random D12 Dwellers biome monster with ARMY tag under your command. You lose a number of levels equivalent to this monster CR. Down to lv. 1.  If monster has more CR than your levels, it instead becomes hostile and joins the daily chasers.
5. Epic Foresight. Target gains Advantage for all tasks and attacks untill the next lost adventure.
6. Physical Immunity. You start each adventure with a count of INDOMITABLE tags equivalent to unused surges.
7. Create Legendary Item. Create D20 Legendary Item of your choice.
8. Death Wind. All cr1 and cr2 creatures in this area die,
    but you gain 3 INFAMY.
9. Antigravity. If have stronghold, you can access it from any area.
   I.e. it is flying above you and you can recruit the armies anywhere.
10. Terraform. Doubles the income you get from city and business in
      this area.

11. Volcano. All daily chasing enemies die, but the area
     turns into mountains and you gain 3 INFAMY.
12. Voidsail. If have OWNSHIP, gain VOIDFARER.
13. Void Breach. Allows one travel to other Void Sphere, as well as sealing Nymara's sphere from voidfaring.
14. Epic Invisibility. You can decide if you want to face daily chasers who reached you.
15. Longevity. Sacrifices entire city (replace it with desert), but your maximum number of SURGEs increases by 3.
16. Earthfast. At your stronghold area creates underground complex,
You can place CAPTIVE monsters there. These monsters can be recruited at will. Hire cost: is monster's CR gp, or 20*CR for hiring as an ARMY.
17. Create Life. Creates a monster which has 10 random tags from the Tags Reference, and joins you as ally.
18. Imbue Fertility. If at plains area, creates a SMALL city. Increases city's size (SMALL->MEDIUM->LARGE).
19. Beckoning Death. If area is city, it is replaced with desert and D12 Dwellers Undead Zombie ARMY joins you (1 army for small city, 2 - for medium, 4 - for large), while you gain 10 INFAMY.
20. Ascend. Gain ESSENCE (and become GOD if not already one),
   but lose 4 levels.
APOTHEOSIS
                            A Lv.8 hero with ESSENCE gains GOD tag in a random
                      D4 Domain (1. Life, 2. Death, 3. Order, 4. Chaos).
     GOD has EPIC tag and and extra SURGE per each ESSENCE it has.
 God can cast epic spells and can pick any monster defeated this adventure to be its avatar. Once per adventure you can transform into that avatar, until you cancel it or gain COMA.
As a lesser god you're subject to the greater deity of your domain, and competing with other lesser gods. Lesser god's goal is access to all domains. 
At MONTH's start, the greater deity assigns you a D6 Lesser Task, unique for each Domain. If got have several domains, you can pick whose domain's errand to do, while discarding the others. If you fail the task, you lose 1 ESSENCE or domain, or, if none, you lose your GOD tag, ceasing being god.
Completing, awards you with ESSENCE tag. You can spend 3 ESSENCE tags to pick additional domain. Spend 1 ESSENCE to learn a new Epic/Ritual spell or to cast a known one.
OBTAINING 1 ESSENCE
1. Build Temple (1000gp) at any city you own or have PATRON.
2. Gain ESPECIFIC from by defeating specific monsters.
3. If VOIDLICH, cast Wish to rob lesser god of its ESSENCE.
4. Complete a D6 Lesser Errand (must be GOD already)
D6 LESSER ERRAND
All foes and tasks during errand are HARD.
"Each NPC" means all NPC at city center and inn.
CHAOS ERRAND
1. Spark Collapse. Seed new D20 City Issue. Chat with 3 Beggars, 3 Children, 3 Drunkards, 3 Preachers and 3 Servants.
2. Desecrate a Relic. Spend relic to cast Beckoning Death, Death Wind or Volcano epic spell.
3. Seed Corruption. Bribe at least 3 Official NPCs with 20gp, when they are in Vending mood.
4. Summon Monsters. Cast Epic Gate spell.
5. Seed Discord. Pay 10gp to at least 6 Performer NPCs in Vending mood to promote madness in their art.
6. Kill Lesser Deity. A D20 Boss with ARMY tag spawns next adventure.
   Defeat it
DEATH ERRAND
1. Judge. A Celestial and a Demon contest a soul.
  Resolve dispute by having 40xp at a single moment.
2. Sanction a D20 Boss defies death at the next explored dungeon area,
    it is UNDEAD and has 2 SURGES. Defeat this boss.
3. Escort a Soul. A random hero joins you. Ensure this hero reaches Lv.3
  and then dies to a cr5+ monster.
4. Silence the Dead. The next D6 Biome adventure has all
  monsters UNDEAD and proceeds until you defeat a cr5+ monster or die.
5. Close Rift. Cast Planar Rift.
6. Collect Souls. Kill 10 Stranger NPCs.
ORDER ERRAND
1. Enforce. Explore a new city and cast Epic Dominate at it.
2. Deliver Edict. Talk with 12 Preacher NPCs.
3. Punish. The next cr5+ monster will instead be Planetar (VHLD dungeon
   boss stats + 2 SURGEs). Defeat it.
4. Mediate. At each of 2 cities talk to 2 Nobles and 2 Officials.
5. Sanctify Prophecy. Cast Epic Foresight.
6. Mentor. A hero joins you until you collect 40xp, while it is not in COMA.
LIFE ERRAND
1. Sanctify Growth. Do Desert Adventure, exploring 20 tiles to plant seeds.
2. End Plague. Do City Adventure at D20 City, neutralizing all NPCs
   with the Odd Mood. Attacking any NPC first will fail this task.
3. Protect Birth. Forest biome Unicorn monster joins you, until you gain at least 30xp, while it isn't in COMA. Lose all XP if unicorn gains COMA.
4. Sanctify Life. Cast Create Life.
5. Promote Fertility. Turn your stronghold into a SMALL city (400gp)
6. Restore Land. Cast Terraform.

HERO GENERATION
                         Start with picking D6 Class, D8 Race, D6 Ability and a
                    random D6 Lapse from the tables below.
Mid-campaign, the party can add a new hero the same way by spending
1 LORE and 10 XP. Mid-campaign joiners never claim FOUNDER unless the
party has none.
   Hero starts with 3 known powers, matching picked class. The rest can be
 learned from scholar NPCs, teaching D12 Class Power.
Unless range specified, target monster on the current tile. 
Reminder: move monster toward you when you attack it with ranged power.
D12 CLASS POWER ([R] means hero is RANGED when using this power.)
At Camping, hero can equip up to 5 powers (DUMB - 3, CLEVER - 8).
If power doesn't specify damage, assume hero's one (STRONG, PUNY...).
Utility powers can be used at any moment. Flip daily powers after use. Spend FAVOR to recharge any daily or utility power. 
 1. D8 FIGHTER AT-WILL 
 2. D8 FIGHTER UTILITY
 3. D5 FIGHTER DAILY
 4. D8 CLERIC AT-WILL
 5. D10 CLERIC UTILITY
 6. D8 CLERIC DAILY
 7. D10 ROGUE AT-WILL
 8. D8 ROGUE UTILITY
 9. D6 ROGUE DAILY
10. D6 MAGE AT-WILL
11. D8 MAGE UTILITY
12. D6 MAGE DAILY
D6 CLASS
Class determines what D12 Class Power hero can equip and bonuses:
1. Fighter: on even roll with melee weapon, gain TIRED to act again.
2. Rogue: on even roll with ranged weapon, gain TIRED to act again.
                  Can attack from backrow with non-[R] powers.
3. Cleric:  when gain INFORMED, recharge 1 daily power.
4. Mage: gain TIRED and spend 5XP to recharge your daily power.
5. Monk: can spend 1 XP to lose TIRED.
6. Druid: can spend 5XP to lose 1 HURT.
Note: unless overruled monsters and NPCs get random D6 Classes.
D8 RACE
A mixed race hero can't have a D6 Ability tag, but rolls D8 Race 2 times. 
Any hero of a given race can equip its powers. Roll d4 here for NPC's race.
1. Human. -4 XP to level up or train a D20 Skill.
2. Dwarf. Can equip Resilience daily power: lose 3 HURT.
3. Elf. Can spend SURGE to gain 5 XP. Can gain TIRED to lose MENTAL.
4. Halfling.  Same-tile ally can take hit meant for you.
5. Goblin. Advantage to monster talk. Spend 10 XP to gain RATION.
6. Dragonkin. Breath: spend 1XP to attack everyone on hero's tile.
 7. Godborn. Gain ESSENCE. 
  8. Wingfolk. Gain FLYER.

D6 ABILITY
1. STRONG. The default hit strength. Can carry 8 items.
   Skills: Athletics
2. TOUGH. Can survive STRONG hit. Instead of HURT can gain TIRED.
   Loses ILL on Camping. Skills: Constitution.
3. AGILE. 
   When gain 2 TIRED, gain 1 instead.
   Skills: Acrobatics / Sleight / Stealth / Concentration
4. WISE. On camping loses MENTAL, while party gains extra 1XP per
    explored tile, while explored tiles count is above XP.
   Skills: Taming / Insight / Medicine / Perception / Survival
5. CLEVER. Can equip 8 powers instead of 5. Can spend 5 XP to reroll dice.
   Skills: Arcana / History / Investigation / Nature / Religion
6. SOCIAL. Can transfer HURT/TIRED/DOOM tags to other hero.
   Skills: Deception / Intimidation / Performance / Persuasion
D6 LAPSE
These cancel the respective numbered D6 Ability.
1. PUNY. The default hit strength. Can carry only 3 items. Skills: Athletics
2. FRAIL. Dies to single non-PUNY hit. Skills: Constitution.
   If ILL can't lose HURT on camp.
3. SLOW. Doesn't gain 1 XP on odd D20 Attack rolls.
   When gain HURT, also gain TIRED. Disadvantage on Escape to any hero.
   Skills: Acrobatics / Sleight / Stealth
4. CRAZY. Needs +5 more XP to gain INFORMED/Level-up or train skill.
   Skills: Taming / Insight / Medicine / Perception / Survival
5. DUMB. Can only equip 3 powers. Can't spend XP to re-roll dice.
   Skills: Arcana / History / Investigation / Nature / Religion
6. LONER.  if gets HURT on odd roll, 1 ally must get HURT too.
   Skills: Deception / Intimidation / Performance / Persuasion
TALENTS, FLAWS, VIRTUES AND ALIGNMENT
Hero gains D20 Talent the moment they roll natural 1.
Next time they roll 1, they gain D20 Virtue.  Hero gains D20 Flaw the moment they roll natural 20. Next time they roll 20,
roll into D20 Map to determine their alignment (true neutral until then).
LEVELING Lv.N hero can level-up on roll 19,20, by spending N LORE  and 4*N XP (5*N if DUMB). On each level-up, hero unlocks additional power. Each level N hero gives party N SURGEs on every camping to their shared pool. On Lv.4 hero gains additional D6 Ability. Heroes gain 1 shared LORE point for each newly explored world map area.
On roll 1, hero with 2 FAVORs loses 2 FAVORS and gains 1 LORE.
D20 BOND
                           Only one hero storyline can be active at a time.
                      FAVOR/DOOM rules here affect only the associated hero.
   Each hero has D20 Descent and the first city hero visits is their home, which has all their D20 Family.
At the beginning hero must complete their D20 Prologue.
Once prologue ends, lose DOOM and gain max FAVOR, then return to home city to roll and complete D8 Catalyst, then roll D20 Journey.
D20 PROLOGUE (events before the main adventure)
To start prologue, do 2 campings and visit your home city. Then:
1-5. Do two quests at home city.
6-10. Dangerous chore. Lose adventure after spawning a CR 5+ monster.
11-14. Seek Opportunities. Visit city other than your home city.
15-16. Explore 6 dungeon tiles. A Mentor (FULFILED PROTECTOR level
   3 hero) joins till D8 Catalyst or the month's end.
17-20. Conscript. You got conscripted to the army. In next Wilds
   Adventure, 2 militia allies join you - cr1 frail puny humanoid from
   D20 Civilized / D12 Dwellers. Spawn monsters from that same biome.
   If you leave, gain WANTED at home city, and INFAMY.
   If you manage to explore 12 tiles, the adventure ends and you gain award:
          Trinket D20 Mundane Item worth 10gp.
    In any case, once adventure ends, got back to your home city.
D20 DESCENT (background where you came from)
Descent determines who you're at the game start, and what
goal you must complete to gain FULFILED.
1-5. Artisan Apprentice. Trained in 3 random D20 Skills.
     Goal: do 10 tasks with each skill.
6-8. Folk Hero. Advantage to talk tasks againt any NPC at home city.
     Goal: complete 1 NPC quest at 5 cities.
9-10. Noble Heir. Gain PATRON at home city and and trained in History.
      You start with a 10gp worth Garment D20 Mundane Item.
      Goal: gain a stronghold real estate.
11-20. A stranger from a far away, without D20 Family
       The 1st city you visit will become your home. See next page.
11. A human person from Earth, transported to Nymara.
  A person calling himself "Mentor" promises to return you
  if you get him Amulet of Yendor, held by a powerful sorcerer
  Nevzar En'rogg. Gain CRPL and HANDGUN. Goal: defeat Nevzar
12. A samurai from far east looking for worthy opponents.
    Gain KATANA. Goal: have 5 ARENAWIN tags.
13. You survived voidfarer vessel crash. Aliens, who killed your team,
    now threaten Nymara. Gain DVSL and MOTION_TRACKER.
    Goal: defeat Brood Queen.
14. An islander whose home was destroyed by a volcanic eruption.
    Gain AMORPHIC and IVLC. Goal: defeat Phoenix
15. A pirate whose ship was sunk by a Kraken, after eating your eye.
   Gain MLST, COMPASS and 6gp. Goal: defeat Kraken
   You know of a hidden treasure of 10+d10 gp at the first sea area explored.
   Reroll it till sea. You need OWNSHIP to get there.
16. A Redclaw agent investigating the aberrant infiltration of old ruins.
    Gain SOULBINDER and AELR. Goal: defeat Mother Brain
17. Time travel left you between a dragon's cave and caustic cube,
    which ate your chronomancy device. Goal: defeat Acid Monolith
    Gain CMC, HOVERBOARD and TIMEUNWIND.
18. A psion, who escaped a US military facility by shifting to Nymara.
    Now voidlich Vocennta wants you in her soul gem collection.
    Gain PSION and STWR. Goal: defeat Vocennta.
19. A vampire who left Umbrath for Nymara after a feud with your master.
    Gain VAMPIRE. Goal: transfer a SMALL city to Umbrath, either
    through Epic Spell or by Umbral Seed (can be found with Greater Scry).
20. A slave escaped from deep dwarf city plagued by  Demogorgon's madness.
     Gain KGHM. Goal: slay Demogorgon.
D8 CATALYST         (event which incites your journey)
1. Your home city got attacked. Roll d20:
    1-10. Your D20 Family perished. 11-20. They are alive.
   City streets now spawn D12 Dwellers biome monsters instead of tasks.
   When you leave area, the city gets replaced by a random D6 Biome,
   and the next city becomes your home.
2. Something is tormenting your home city. Disadvantage to any task there,
    until D20 Journey is complete, yet you have +5 Investigation bonus.
3. Chance to prove yourself. You can spend lv-up XP to lose 1 DOOM.
4. Stumbled upon a cursed D20 Legendary Item. Roll D20 Torment
      Instead of journey. The item can be destroyed through epic spell.

                               5.  Your FRIEND from home city is missing.
                                  Upon completing D20 Journey, roll d20:
                                  1-5. They're dead. Re-roll your D20 Virtue 
                                6-10. They're aligned with enemy and daily chase you.
                                  If you defeat them, reroll your D20 Flaw.
                              11-20. Were Kidnapped/enslaved.
                                   They are back home, and give you 10gp on 1st visit.
6. Your have FRIEND at your home city, who needs your help.
   If you're FRAIL, the contact offers join till D20 Journey is over.
7-8. Got yourself into trouble. Roll D20 Torment, instead of D20 Journey.
   If 5, you're also EXILED: gain 2 DOOM each time you revisit HOME city.
   Lose EXILED. gain FULFILED when this torment is over.
D20 JOURNEY (The catalyst event triggered your journey)
Before rolling it, pay for BOOZE at a tavern - signifies the reveal to allies.
The hero gains FULFILED once the associated goal is achieved
See Dungeons section for the associated dungeon tags.
Complete goal in 12 MONTHs or roll D6 Global Issue, which persists till journey is complete.
1. You came into possession of a mine, which suffers bug infestation.
   Gain ABMN. Goal: defeat Remorhaz
2. You believe money can solve it. Goal: have 200gp
   At a D20 City know an NPC who owes you 5 + d20 gp.
   That NPC will appear on the 5th tile, in addition to other NPCs
3. You've to see the world. Goal: visit all biome types and cities of all sizes.
4. A shady sorceress promises to fix it if you steal a few Veilguard trinkets.
   Gain VHLD. Goal: enter into treasury tile
5. Ruins are the key! Gain WHIP. Visit D20 City. The 1st Scholar NPC there
   happens to be a history professor, who asks to do archaeological research:
   at each of 5 D20 Areaes, explore 10 tiles. Gain max FAVOR each time.
   Afterwards speak with the professor: the Anauroch pyramid is culprit.
   Gain PRMD. Goal: defeat Mummy Lord
6. God trusted you with D4 Domain, D6 Lesser Task. Goal: Complete it 
   to gain ESSENCE, and ability to cast a random D20 Ritual Spell.
7. Tyrant must be stopped! At home city get to the lord,
   who upon death transforms into D20 Generated Monster + 20.
   Goal: defeat the monster.


8. Pilgrimage will help! Goal: visit 20 D20 Areas,
   gaining  FAVOR at each. Areas can be at sea.
   Goal: visit all areas to gain FULFILED.
9. Revolution at your home. Talk to every Beggar, Farmer and
    Servant to  gain PATRON + max FAVOR.
    Goal: Kill every guard/official/noble there.
10. Giants are culprit! Speak to 3 Scholar NPCs at
    3 D20 Cities, you can get training allowing you to deal
    2x damage to giants. Goal: Kill a giant in each biome.
11. Hunting animals will help. Goal: Kill every D6 Animal in every biome
    beside Umbrath. Gain FAVOR for each new animal.
12. Your eccentric relative disappeared at Starhaven, leaving an voidfarer
    vessel at Starhaven's dry dock. See Voidfarer. Goal: rescue relative.
    1. Pay Smuggler/Fence 20gp to learn about D20 NPC at D20 City,
         who can smuggle you on voidfarer going to the city of Starhaven;
    2. Travel to that city and locating that NPC.
    3. Paying said NPC 40gp to smuggle you.
    4. Once at Starhaven, pay 40gp parking fees.
         At this point you have ownership over the voidfarer vessel.
    5. Visit 3 FRIENDs, whom you have a the next 3 discovered cities.
    6.  Travel through 5*N areas from respective place to meet
          Nth of these contacts.
    7. Once spoke with all contacts, Travel (D15 Arcana) to the asteroid,
        and do the Prison Break section to free your relative.
        You relative will stay at Starhaven.
13. Cultists led by Dulsa Thoom responsible. Gain SRPTMPL.
       Goal: defeat Dulsa Thoom
14. Naga infestation enraged gods. Gain RSGT. Goal: defeat Dark Nagas
15. Dream invading night hags. Gain: NHC. Goal: defeat Night Hags
16. A mortician involved in disappearance of numerous people,
      turned to be a Fleshweaver, turning reanimated corpses stolen from
      the other planes into his slaves. Gain OSWRM. Goal: defeat Fleshweaver
17. Local tyrant. Goal: kill the lord at your home city, who on death turns
     into D20 Generated Monster, add 15 to its d20 roll.
18. A monster rampaging countryside (see Tarrasque).
      Goal: defeat Tarrasque, spawned at D20 Map Dir (home relative).
19-20. Random Villain. Either cast Greater Scry, or talk with 3 innkeepers.
     and succeed REAL Investigation to locate D20 Area, with the
    villain: D20 Boss. Goal: kill it.
D20 TORMENT
                             Update chase scenes at the start of Camping.

    1. Infamy.  Do daily chase to avoid gaining max DOOM and 5 INFAMY.
        Goal: clean your name by completing a D20 Journey.
2. Nemesis. A powerful D20 Boss with NEMESIS is chasing you.
    Each time they defeat you, lose a level.
3. Escaped slave. A group of 5 D20 NPCs with 2 SURGE are chasing you.
    Each time they defeat you, lose a level, gain 10 days and appear at
    D20 Area. Chasers stop chasing once you defeat them.
4. You owe 200gp to The Nexus. You must pay 10gp each month,
   or D20 Boss starts EASY Chase. If it defeats you, lose all your money and
   items to cover the debt, and the chase repeats next month.
5. Possessed. At day 20 of each month do REAL to avoid it gaining
    control  over you. If it gains control, roll D20 Prophecy. You must
    complete it till next 20th day or lose a level and gain 3 DOOM.
    If you fail prophecy 5 times in a row, the possessor spawns and attacks:
    Goal: Defeat D20 Boss who has 2 SURGEs.
6. You're a rogue clone of another being, who now does DC 20 d20 Chase.
   That person has your exact stats, but 5 SURGEs.
   They act on every foe phase. If they defeat you, lose level, and reset chase.
7. Chased by a D20 City Villain. You know 4 D20 City Issue bits so can
   reveal the plot. All guards and officials at that city are hostile to you.
   Until the issue is solved, an 5 armies of Militia are chasing you.
   If you meet any Blackmailer, Smuggler or Emissary NPC, and let
   them  live, this chase distance gets reduced to 1. Goal: defeat Villain.
8.  At the end of every month you lose all money.  d6+4 NPCs spread along
   D20 Cities are responsible. Goal: neutralize all of them.
9.  You're responsible for mentoring an NPC, who travels with you
   on a D20 Journey. The NPC maintains the same tile as you,
   and monsters prioritize attacking NPC. Each time this NPC dies you
   lose all FAVOR and gain max DOOM. Spend 15 XP to promote this NPC
   to a hero, with Ability and Lapse. Goal: complete the journey, then
   the NPC leaves you to settle at a D20 City. They're now your friend.
10. A coven of night hags (same as NHC dungeon) from
  D20 Area haunts your dream. Before each Camping,
  do EASY task to avoid dream adventure, where this hero must
  explore d8 tiles of D6 Biome. Other heroes can join only if  any hero
  has PSION, or Divination + True Seeing, or Detect Thoughts +
  Telekinesis. Damage and XP carries to real life, but no items. On defeat
  you wake up with lost level and DOOM tags. The hags appear on the 6th
  dream tile. Defeat hags at their area or in a dream to stop nightmares.
11. Gain D20 Legendary Item. You've daily chase to avoid fighting heroes
   total level CR of D12 Dwellers Undead minions, sent by a Lich, wanting
   this. If you get defeated sharing tile with them, lose that Legendary Item.
   If you defeat minions, the daily chase gets reset with new undead minions.
   Goal: defeat Lich D20 Boss, who will spawn as a BOSS the next dungeon.
         if you lost item, defeating Lich will give it back to you.
12. You've daily Chase to avoid fighting Tiamat. Defeat Red, Green, Blue, White and Black dragons for their scales. After 1st dragon gain DRAGONSLAYER. Got all scales? A Blacksmith can forge armor (10gp)  which negates Tiamat's ARMY and SURGEs, and Tiamat's hit is now PUNY.
Tiamat cr9 epic strong tough slow absurd ranged vorous binder large
        2surge healing kicker confuser blaster archmage dread army reptile
* Loot: ESSENCE and TMTDOWN tag
Once defeated, Tiamat, won't ever attack you again.
If Tiamat defeats you, the daily chase just resets.
13-14. Curse. Each MONTH lose 1 FAVOR and gain 1 DOOM.
   Goal: defeat 1 BOSS.
15-16. For each DOOM tag you have, gain additional HURT on hit.
   Goal: buy a SURGE Training from a Scholars D20 NPC.
17-18. Trial. Can't enter city houses. Goal: defeat a foe in each D6 Biome
19-20. This hero can't level-up. Goal:  defeat a foe in 3 D12 Dwellers.
D20 VIRTUE
                          Once the virtue's needs are met, gain PIOUS.  If have PIOUS, on
                   month end? - Lose it and gain 2 FAVOR+15 XP.  NPC virtue
    is learned on Study. NPC follows its virtue, if you succeed chat task.
 1. Just. Kill an evil NPC. Spend 5XP to detect if somebody is evil.
   Lose PIOUS if kill non-evil NPC. If NPC, become hostile if hero is evil.
2. Enlightened. Talk with 3 Scholar NPCs.
   If NPC, hero can do History task to gain FAVOR.
3. Guardian. Do 3 NPC quests. If NPC, joins till hero enter this/other city;
4. Humble. Do 2 NPC quests, but refuse reward. If NPC, lose FUNDRAISER
5. Honest. Do 3 persuasion tasks till HURT. If NPC, lose ODD.
6. Cautious. Do adventure while having PREPARED, Torch and 3 RATIONs.
     If NPC, heroes get Disadvantage to any task against you.
7. Curious. Explore 4 new areas.
   If NPC, instead of annoyed become Pursuer; hero has +10 History at you.
8. Pacifist. Complete 3 travel adventures without killing anybody.
   If NPC, disappear if ANNOYED.
9. Respectful. Gain PIOUS on 1st month day. Lose it if any NPC on your tile becomes ANNOYED. If NPC, won't lose CALM, unless HURT.
10. Generous. Spend 10gp on FUNDRAISER NPCs. 
       If NPC, offer 4x the reward.
11. Visionary. Roll D20 Prophecy - succeed it.
       If NPC, hero hiring you automatically succeeds at prophecies.
12. Stoic. Gain MENTAL, BOUND and ILL (together or separately)
       If NPC, takes MENTAL/BOUND/ILL for the hiring hero, unless
        already has such condition.
13. Devout. Gain PIOUS on 1st month day, lose if gain DOOM or MENTAL.
      If NPC, refuses to talk to hero without FAVOR.
14. Brave. Start and succeed travel adventure while HURT and frontrow.
     If NPC, takes HURT for the hiring hero.
18. Loyal. Inform your faction's agent - 1st Stranger NPC.
    If NPC, won't abandon hero if it fails to pay the wage, but gains DOOM.
19. Merciful. Gain PIOUS on 1st month day. Don't kill any PUNY monster,
    or NPC.  If NPC,  hiring hero gains 5 for escaping PUNY monster.
20. Hardworking. Camp with 25 XP 3 times. If NPC, gives extra SURGE to heroes who camp with 25 XP.
15. Clever. Succeed 5 Investigation tasks.
    If NPC, Investigation advantage to hiring hero
                  16. Extroverted. Succeed chat with 5 NPCs.
                        If NPC, Persuasion advantage to hiring hero
                 17. Athlete. Succeed 5 Athletics tasks.
                        If NPC, Athletics advantage to hiring hero
D20 FLAW
Once the flaw's needs are met, gain INDULGED. Got INDULGED
on month end? - lose it and gain 2 FAVOR,  otherwise - gain
2 DOOM. To fail a task, attack it till it HURT you.  Learn NPC's flaw, if
Study that NPC, or it is ANNOYED.  NPC follows its flaw if gets annoyed.
1. Greedy. You wealth must be 10gp higher than the previous month.
   If NPC, paying your salary money makes you LEISURE.
2. Homesick. Visit your home city.
   If NPC, joins and pays 4x its gp once at the next explored city.
3. Careless. Chat to a 2 Stranger NPCs, without Study. Complete 2 travels
   un-PREPARED. If NPC, hero gains Advantage on any Chat task.
4. Impulsive. Gain INDULGED on month start. Lose if bound/non-frontrow.
    If NPC, become GUARD.
5. Preacher. Talk with 5 zealot NPCs doing REAL Religion task (preach).
   If NPC, hero gains DOOM.
6. Kleptomaniac. Pickpocket 3 NPCs. If NPC, steal hero's
    gold or any item which costs more than hero has gold.
7. Bhaalist. Kill 3 NPCs. If NPC - HOSTILE+EPIC+RAGER.
8. Paranoid. Study 5 NPCs. Lose INDULGED if leave city un-PREPARED.
   If NPC, hero can do EASY Intimidation to take your wage+Wares.
9. Devious. Once a MONTH kill a hired NPC for 4x its wage and Wares. 
   If NPC, heroes lose all XP.
10. Coward. Gain INDULGED on month start. Lose if attack a strong target.
    If NPC, hero can do Deception task to gain that NPC's wage and Wares.
11. Introvert. Fail 3 Persuasion/Performance tasks. Lose INDULGED if
   attack on a tile with other heroes. If NPC, hero has talk tasks Disadvantage.
12. Lazy. Gain INDULGED on 1st month day.
   Lose INDULGED if gain 20+ XP.
   If NPC, pays 2x the normal amount for any quest you will do for them.
13. Clumsy. Break item worth your level * 5gp.
  If NPC, heroes have Advantage to Sleight against you.
14. Liar. Do 5 Deception tasks. If NPC,  heroes lose all gp.
15. Prejudiced. HURT 3 NPCs of different race. If NPC, become hostile.
16. Obsessed. Buy 5x trinket Mundane Item. If NPC, pays 4x for trinkets.
17. Mean. Fail 3 Intimidation tasks. If NPC, heroes lose a SURGE.
18. Dependent. Gain INDULGED on 1st month day.
    Always share a tile with other hero (even if in COMA).
    If NPC, heroes have intimidation task Advantage on NPC's tile.
19. Insane. Gain MENTAL 3 times. If NPC, gain MENTAL and get Hostile
20. Festive. Share Drink 5 times. If NPC, gain LEISURE + give hero BOOZE
D20 TALENT


    1. Student. At D20 City, don't leave for 6 campings, every 2 campings
   get training in one of your skills. Once done, gain D20 Skill Mastery in
   one of the trained skills - you become a docent teaching it, employed at a
   D20 City. Every month gain DOOM or do a lecture there: HARD task on
   that skill to gain 20gp and FAVOR.
   To change place of employment talk with 3 Scholar NPCs at another city
2. Gain RAGESTRIKE.
3. Gain WEREWOLF.
4. Gain ENTREPRENEUR.
5. At night gain HIDDEN upon entering a tile, but GAWKY during day.
6. When you roll a natural 1, summon D20 Boss ally, without its EPIC.
    This ally disappears next Camping. Its type stays same after 1st summon.
7. Half-beast. +1 XP per tile in Forest/Mountains. No XP on city tiles.
8. Psionic abilities. Gain PSION
9. Deity Protege. If have no SURGES and there is a Hostile creature
   on tile, spend FAVOR to cast Wish spell.
10. Forgotten god heals you (lose all HURT) and grants you FAVOR tag.
    They need a Herald. At each of 5 large cities, talk with a Performer
    NPC in a Vending mood, paying 2gp to proclaim that god's return.
    You gain FAVOR each time and FULFILED when task is completed.
    As a cult leader. You can mobilize 1 NPCs at every such city.
    The NPCs act as if hired normally, but don't ask money.
11. Menace of D6 Biome. A robber or a forest protector.
      Gain FAVOR for any NPC neutralized there. 
      Failure earns you DOOM. 
12. Petbound. You start with trained Taming.
   Do REAL to get a single familiar (see finding familiar).
   Now once a day you can replace an task skill with Taming.
   If familiar dies, lose all FAVOR, gain max DOOM.
   You can only get new familiar after you roll natural 20.
13. Slimy. Spend FAVOR to lose all INFAMY.
14. Scholar. Spend FAVOR to gain 50 XP.
15. Prophet. You automatically succeeds at D20 Prophecy.
16. Concentration. Spend FAVOR to double the attack/skill bonus to roll.
17. Chameleon. Every 10 days spend FAVOR to re-roll D20 Flaw or Virtue.
18. Doppelganger. Spend FAVOR to gain Disguised.
19. Hiker. Spend FAVOR to be allowed to travel again after failed travel DC.
20. Shapechanger. Spend FAVOR to turn into NPC / creature you spawned
       today. Till next long rest you gain this creature's tags.
D6 DISABILITY
For a hero with N DOOM tags, if monster hits this hero rolling 20 or hero fails task with roll 1, then roll d10 and if it is below N, hero gains disability.
Cast Wish or spend ESSENCE to discard all disabilities.
1. Concussion. Gain CRAZY+DUMB.
2. Lost Eye. Gain GAWKY, monsters got BLINDING to you. 
3. Lost Arm.  Lose a Level and Gain PUNY. 
4. Lost leg. Gain SLOW and on each Camping gain BOUND.
5. Depression. Gain LONER. On each Camping gain MENTAL.
6. Systemic. Gain FRAIL. Gain ILL on Camping.
D20 PROPHECY
Make a number N between 1 and 20. Spend 3x that XP and
roll d20, if at or below N, you have succeeded.

                                  D6 MAGE AT-WILL POWER
                              1. Magic Missile[R]. Spend 2 FOCUS, target gains HURT
                         2. Fire Arrow[R]. PUNY attack non-AGILE target.
     3. Acid Mist[R]. Spend 3 FOCUS to STRONG BLASTER ACID attack
          non-TOUGH foes
  4. Etherealness. Spend 2 FOCUS to become PHASED until you leave tile.
  5. Wizard Eye. Gain TIRED to spawn eye token. The eye is MEEK but
      otherwise can do anything you can, and disappears after a single action. 
 6. Invisibility. Spend 2 XP to become HIDDEN until you leave this tile.
D8 MAGE UTILITY POWER
1. Lesser Illusion. Spend 5 XP to gain DISGUISED.
2. Mirror Image. Spend 3 XP to gain MIRRORED.
3. Cartomancer. Spend 3 XP to use random D12 Class daily power.
4. Alarm. Mage can rest for just 1 XP (3 if night/dungeon and no light).
5. Alacrity. Spend 2XP to use 2 (3 if INFORMED) different powers instead of 1
6. Adept. Spend 1 XP before roll to make target take extra 2 HURT on hit.
7. Antimagic.  For any non D20 Attack HURT, you can take TIRED instead.
8. Versatility. Flip off a power to gain 3 FOCUS and flip on another power.

D6 MAGE DAILY POWER
1. Dimension Door. All monsters on tile lose PURSUER. Move all heroes to picked exit, you can act again.
2. Fireball[R]. All non-THICK frontrow on tile suffer STRONG attack.
3. Flaming Sphere. Spawn Flaming Sphere cr1 phased puny spirit. After 5 attacks, it disappears.
4. Arcane Blast[R]. Gain N tired to do N PUNY attacks at once.
5. Finger of Death. Mage spends 2 FOCUS to kill cr1-4 target,
     or give 2 HURT to cr5+ target.
6. Warmage Form. You gain STRONG, TOUGH and 3 fighter
   powers for the duration of this adventure, but can't use mage's powers.
   You can cancel this effect at will.

D8 FIGHTER AT-WILL POWER
1. True Strike: default attack.
2. Double Strike: attack with Disadvantage, but twice.
3. Charge. Explore tile 1 tile, move there and do PUNY attack:
4. Evasive Strike. If target attacks and misses you, you hit it.
5. Bow[R]: default strength attack.
6. Ready Strike. Spend 2 XP to kill non-AGILE / non-TOUGH monster.
7. Cautious Strike. You hit PUNY and only on even roll, but gain 1 XP.
8. Risky Strike. Disadvantage attack, but kills non-TOUGH on 19,20.
D8 FIGHTER UTILITY POWER
1. Divert. You can take a monster card from another hero.
       That monster now attacks you given a choice.
2. Assist. You can take TIRED from another hero.
3. Regroup. When a monster is spawned, move this and other heroes,
    even if already moved this turn. For chase scene get +/- 2 bonus to rolls.
4. Organize. Gain TIRED to allow another hero to re-roll any dice.
5. Protect. When a hero on your tile is attacked, you become the target
   instead, but the attack on you goes with Advantage.
6. Persist. Gain HURT to re-roll a die.
7. Stoicism. Gain 2 TIRED to lose HURT.
8. Indomitable. Spend FAVOR to discard a hit killing you. 
D5 FIGHTER DAILY POWER
1. Taunt. Explore adjacent tile, move the 1st spawned monster to your tile
     and STRONG attack it (miss: PUNY hit).
     Other monsters spawned on explored tile are non-PURSUERS.
2. Interpose. Move to a tile with target ally, without spending an action.
3. Furious Strike. STRONG attack a monster. Miss: PUNY hit
     Unless missed, the power starts enabled and you can act again this round.
4. Comeback. lose 2 HURT, attack STRONG
5. Leadership. Your foes can't act until you finish your next round.
                                    D8 CLERIC AT-WILL POWER
                              1. Strike: default strength attack.
                        2. Spirit Shroud: PUNY, but on 18-20 any hero loses HURT.
      3. Command. Gain 1 TIRED, the target attacks itself.
   4. Spiritual Shield. A single target of your choice has THICK
 5. Detect Alignment. Spend 1 XP and roll into the D20 Map.
   Hero of different alignment gets Advantage to opposite alignment target.
6. Protect Against Alignment. Spend 1 FOCUS to make targets of known alignment CALM.
7. Regeneration. Target gains HEALING. Use again to change target.
8. Lay on Hands. If no enemy on tile, the target with 3 HURT loses 1.
D10 CLERIC UTILITY POWER
1. Life Transference. Gain HURT+TIRED, target loses 3 HURT.
2. Perseverance. Can gain HURT to inflict 2 HURT to task.
3. Virtue's Touch. Spend 10 XP to end menta/bound/ill for the target.
4. Blessing. Heroes get Advantage to targets of yours opposite alignment.
5. Armor of Faith. D20 Attacks to you get Disadvantage unless you acted.
6. Turn Undead. Heroes have Advantage against any Undead.
7. Deliverance. Spend 20 XP to lose DOOM.
8. Martyrdom. Gain HURT, TIRED and 5 XP.
9. Divine Intervention. When you use a SURGE, lose ILL/BOUND/MENTAL and all HURT.
10. Wall of Faith. Spend 10 XP to escape to picked exit.
D8 CLERIC DAILY POWER
1. Harm: cr1-3 target gains 3 HURT, cr4 - 2 HURT, other targets - 1 HURT.
2. Divine Word. All enemies within 2 tiles get PUNY hit +move 1 tile away.
3. Healing Word. Each hero on your tile loses 1 HURT.
4. Restoration: Each hero on your tile loses 1 status condition.
5. Necromancy: Raises at full health a 1-4 cr monster as an undead ally with 1 HURT tag. The ally lasts till the next Camping, appearing on world map.
6. Clairvoyance. Explore 5 tiles. The spawned monsters are not PURSUER
7. Blade Barrier. Each foe on tile suffers PUNY attack on your activation.
    Lasts till you leave tile.
8. Cause Fear. All foes on tile gain MENTAL. You gain SCARY.

D10 ROGUE AT-WILL POWER
1. Sure Strike. Spend 3 FOCUS to hit target.
2. Crossbow[R]. normal attack strength
3. Gambler Strike. Hit - target gains 3 HURT. Miss - you gain HURT
4. Hide. Spend 1 FOCUS to become HIDING until you get hit.
5. Dash. Move 3 tiles, without triggering attacks of opportunity, if you do action during move, you turn ends immediately.
6. Flee. Spend 2 XP (1 XP if INFORMED) to feely escape alone.
7. Flanking Strike. If other hero on tile and non-AGILE target has no allies
    on tile, Advantage attack target,
8. Daggers[R]. If backrow, PUNY attack all non-THICK enemies on tile.
9. Set Trap. Any hero can instead of move activate the trap:
   everyone on tile takes PUNY attack. Trap is removed after triggering.
   INFORMED rogue can set 2 traps at once, without deactivating previous.
10. Poisoned Dart[R]: MEEK TOXIC attack with Advantage, but you are VENOMOUS while equip this power.
D8 ROGUE UTILITY POWER
1. Haste. Gain TIRED to act two times.
2. Ruse. Bet if your next roll succeeds, if it does you get 4 XP, fails - TIRED.
3. Dodge. Advantage against ranged attacks.
4. Finesse. Attack with Disadvantage, but on hit target gains extra HURT.
5. Cunning. Do deception task to give d4 HURT to a monster.
6. Bardship. +2 to talk. You can cast Divine Voice (see Common Spells).
7. Scouting. Before exploring a tile, do REAL Stealth to see its content.
8. Reflexes. Spend 1 XP to move 1 tile, after a monster/encounter/trap is
      spawn. Don't trigger traps / counter-attacks.
D6 ROGUE DAILY POWER
1. Fury of Blows (4x times): PUNY attack
2. Hit and Run. STRONG attack non-AGILE enemy (miss: PUNY hit)
             Hit or miss, you can move within 3 tiles.
3. Shelter. Swap places with ally and act again.
4. Retaliate. Gives 3 HARM to the last monster who hit you on this tile.
5. Preparedness. If have ILL/MENTAL/BOUND, discard them and act again.
6. Evasion. Foes can't attack you till your next round.  Doesn't take action.


                                   D6 DRUID AT-WILL POWER
                              1. Thorn Strike. Default strength attack.
                        2. Shot Spines[R]. SLOW PUNY TOXIC attack, but
                                 You are VENOMOUS, while equip this power.
      3. Entangle[R]. MEEK BOUND attack; hero is HUNTER while equipped.
  4. Nature Smith. Gain 2 TIRED to craft a 0gp D20 Mundane Item.
 5. Shape Earth. Spend 2XP to remove obstruction from tile exit.
6. Insect Swarm. SLOW MEEK TOXIC BLASTER attack, but hero is SCAVENGER while equip this power.
D4 DRUID UTILITY POWER
1. Telekinesis. SLOW PUNY attack spawned monster.
2. Nature's Bond. In a forest biome, when Druid gains 1 XP, gain 2 instead.
3. Commune with Animals. Beasts/Animals are not hostile, unless attacked.
    +2 XP when exploration spawns animals/beasts.
4. Awareness: can enter secret tiles without spending XP, know the result of
    this hero using a D20 Prop.
D4 DRUID DAILY POWER
1. Nature's Wrath. All foes on tile: SLOW STRONG attack (miss: PUNY HIT).
2. Summon Animals. Summon d4 animal allies from D6 Biome. They disappear on next Camping.
3. Charm Animal. cr1-3 (1-4 if informed) beast gains CHARMED PURSUER
4. Animal Shape. While animal, you can't use other powers.
   Turn back once the animal is dead, or you decide so.
   Damage to animal form don't transfer to your human form.
   Roll d20 to determine which animal you transform into
   1-5.  Wolf cr1 agile puny beast
   6-9. Boar cr2 easy binder paralyzer beast
   10-15. Bear cr2 tough beast
   16-18. Ursowl cr3 tough hard agile strong beast
   19-20. Phase Cat cr4 tough agile quick mirrored hard thick beast
D6 MONK AT-WILL POWER
1. Punch. Default attack. Can be modified by up to 3 XP.
2. Kick. default attack. On hit can move target 2 tiles away
3. Fury of Blows (all enemies on tile). PUNY attack.
4. Radian Bolt[R]. PUNY attack.
5. Voidstep. Till your next attack, enemies have Disadvantage attacking you. 
6. Astral Step. Become Invisible if no enemy within 2 tiles.
D8 MONK UTILITY POWER
1. Deflect Missile. Reroll any non-STRONG ranged hitting you.
2. Radiant Shield. Monster hitting you in melee suffers PUNY attack.
3. Purity of Body. Can't be ILL.
4. Empty Body. Gain 2 TIRED to deflect any hit / ILL/MENTAL/BOUND.
5. Still Mind. Can't be MENTAL.
6. Premonition. Can act after exploring a tile.
7. Resilience. Takes normal hit intead of strong, puny instead of normal.
8. Serpent's Motion. You are CLIMBER and SWIMMER.
D6 MONK DAILY POWER
1. Blazing Arc. Default strength AGILE BLASTER KICKER attack.
2. Thunder Fist. gain SHOCKER, all foes suffer default strength
    MENTAL attack.
3. Sunburst. Spend 3 FOCUS: all foes on tile gain 2 HURT.
4. Mental Focus. +10 to any task (i.e. spend up to 10 xp to modify roll).
5. Aetherstep. Move within 3 tiles and attack with Advantage.
6. Transcendence. If has COMA, use this power and roll d20:
   11-20 - you reappear with 1 HURT (no HURT if INFORMED).
ALLIES
Phantom Steed cr1 frail puny summoned spirit
Arcane Hand cr1 frail flyer summoned spirit. Powers:
* Punch: STRONG attack; Grasp: FEBLE + EASY Grappled.
* Interpose: Takes HURT inplace of ally on the same tile.
* Move: move within 2 tiles together any adjacent size=1 target.
Pegasus cr4 tough strong agile flyer mount beast
Pegasus is reachable through the Integrating Modules.
its dungeon follows the D20 Dungeon setup. Do HARD Taming or
Soul Cage to capture it.

TAGS REFERENCE
                              ACID: Inflicts WORN on hit
                    ARCHMAGE: If TIRED count isn't above HURT,
                    gain FOCUS. If have 3 FOCUS, gain TIRED and cast D20 Ritual
 ANOMALOUS: if it misses frontrow foe, roll d4: 1. Inflicts ILL+MENTAL;
      2. Inflicts d4-1 HURT; 3. Gains VENOMOUS; 4. Gains CONFUSER.
ARMY: TOUGH, EPIC and has Advantage against any non-ARMY, which is
    FRAIL, EASY and PUNY, and has Disadvantage. ARMY with COMA gets
    replaced by non-ARMY without HURT or COMA.
BANE: non-CLEVER MENTAL foes are PUNY and FRAIL while on its tile 
BINDER: hits with BOUND
BLASTER: If TIRED count isn't above HURT, gain TIRED and attack all frontrow foes (backrow if no frontrow)
BRACED: fails D20 Attack / foes hits it - reroll once. Hit/evaded? - lose.
BLINDING: if a MENTAL foe misses hit, move it on adjacent unexplored tile.
BLOCKER: a foe entering your tile, can't leave this tile same way.
BRAWLER: attacks anyone on tile. Lose BRAWLER if anyone on tile dies.
BOSS: if it gets defeated, its allies will disappear and heroes gain 2 LORE.
BUTCHER: Advantage against any HURT target
CAPTIVE. backrow meek moves with captor. Lose captive if no front-row foes
CALM: Doesn't attack. Unless got hit first (all NPCs by default).
CASTER: If TIRED isn't above HURT, gain TIRED to cast D20 Mage Spell
CAUSTIC: If attacked with non-magical weapon, attacker gains WEAR.
CHAMPION: if non-STRONG/EPIC/TOUGH foes misses, go to adjacent tile.
CHARGER: if any foe is bound, gains BANE+DEMENTER+STRONG+BLASTER
CHARMED: Can't attack foes, but must attack ally. Loses CHARMED on hit. 
CHARMER: if foe miss, each non-BOUND MENTAL foe attacks its ally/itself.
CHILLER: if foe misses you, it gains BOUND.
CLIMBER: Advantage attacking foes of larger size: tiny<small<medium<large.
CLONE: If the clone has COMA, spawn real actor at the start tile.
COATED: THICK, HARD and TOUGH unless HURT
CONFUSER: MENTAL foes are MESSY
COWARD: Always backrow. Moves to adjacent tile get hit or a STRONG foe.
CURSER: on hit inflict d6: 1. MENTAL; 2. ILL; 3. BOUND; 4. DOOM
DEMENTER: inflicts MENTAL on hit.
DOOMER: gives DOOM on hit with roll 1-5
DISGUISED: can't be hit. Lose it if hit foe/leave tile with foe / foe is SEEING.
DREAD: if foe misses you, it gains MENTAL
 DYING: Gains HURT each time it hits foe.
             ENGULFER: A non-ranged foe who hits this actor gains BOUND.
             EPIC: Needs 6 HURT to become Unconscious (normal just 3).
ESCAPER: On death spawns monsters unless BOUND.
EXPLOSIVE: On death everyone tile suffer attack:
   STRONG if it was TOUGH, PUNY if FRAIL, else - NORMAL.
FAST: attacks non-AGILE opponent twice.
FIREFRAIL: FRAIL, PUNY and non-EPIC if any foe has FIRE.
FLYER: Non-ranged[R] non-flyer attacks have Disadvantage
FOUL: ILL foes must gain TIRED to target it.
FREE: immune to BOUND
GAWKY: Attacks with Disadvantage.
GREEDY: disappears if given its CR gp.
GROWING: gains a tag each time foe misses it, 
      FRAIL -> NORMAL -> TOUGH -> EPIC -> COATED -> HEALING
GUARD: attacks foes on its own tile but never pursues them (never gains PURSUER).
HIDING: till it got hit, foes without SEEING have Disadvantage to it.
HAZARD: foe who misses it with melee attack gains HURT
HEALING: Each turn if TIRED < HURT, gains TIRED to lose 1 HURT
HELPER: allies have Advantage attacking BOUND/ILL/MENTAL foes
HUNTER: Advantage at BOUND foes, who cant move and have Disadvantage
HURTPROOF: Can't gain HURT.
INCITER: allies gain FAST
INFESTER: on hit BOUND foe becomes INFESTED.
IMMOBILE: can't move or pursue foes.
INDOMITABLE: ignores hit, but loses 1 INDOMITABLE. 
KICKER: when hits, move target to adjacent unexplored tile.
LATE: loses PURSUER on hit; disadvantage against AGILE.
LEADER: allies on its tile are TOUGH, INFORMED and have Advantage.
LUCID: immune to MENTAL
MOUNT: Can be mounted by smaller actor. See Mounting.
NEMESIS: has Advantage against anyone with DOOM tag.
MESSY: on miss hits frontrow or (if none) its own row ally.
MIRE: EPIC and HEALING unless any foe on tile has FIRE.
MIRRORED: attack Advantage, but attack on it has Disadvantage. If you
hit this target, roll d20: 1-10 it is unhurt but loses MIRRORED. If any foes
has SEEING, lose MIRRORED immediately.
MORPHER: if ILL foes misses you, it turns into D6 Animal, while on this tile.
NULLIFIER: foes have no CASTER on tile with you
NUMB: can't talk or be talked to.
PARASITE: can't be hit while any foe is ILL
PARALYZER: BOUND foes can't attack or move, while on your tile.
PHASED: spend 4 XP once or be cr4+/informed to target this entity.
PLAGUE: non-LONER ILL foes are PUNY and FRAIL while on its tile

                                 PRECISE: Attacks with Advantage
                               PROTECTOR: gains TIRED instead of any ally being hit.
                          PURE: immune to ILL.
        PUPPETEER: can't be hit while any non-BOUND foe is MENTAL
   PURSUER: no foe here but foe on adjacent tile - move there.
                     A non-GUARD+non-CALM gains PURSUER on tile with a foe
PSION: uses PSIONICS attack
PYROPHOBIC: has Disadvantage if anyone has FIRE. 
QUICK: foes are SLOW while on tile with you
RISING: each time foe misses it gains a tag:
      PUNY ->   BLASTER -> NORMAL -> STRONG -> FAST -> ARMY
ROWBUST: Always frontrow. Can't move to backrow (even COWARD)
RAGER: if has 2 HURT less than 3 TIRED, gain TIRED to attack twice.
RANGED: Can attack backrow foes, protected by frontrow one.
RETRIBUTOR: any HURT foe deals to you/allies is duplicated to foe.
SCARY: MENTAL foe must gain DOOM and become ILL to attack it
SCAVENGER: Advantage attacking ILL foes. Lose TIRED if hit ILL target.
SEER: Foe misses you? - gain its CR XP. See Alignment, No task study NPC.
SENDER: can spend 1 XP to spawn Channel entity, which is a HURTPROOF PURSUER for the target ally. While this ally isn't in COMA and you're on another tile, this Channel entity can act as if it was you.
SHADOW: Each time it inflicts COMA, it spawns a Shadow D20 Undead ally.
SHAMAN: if foe hits you, cast D20 Cantrip
SHELTER: Bound actors cant be targeted / target non-self/task. Lose if exit.
SHOCKER: MENTAL foes get Disadvantage on all rolls.
SICKER: if foe misses you, it gains ILL.
SLOWER: all BOUND foes are SLOW.
SPAWNER: if foe misses you rolling 1-5, spawn current biome monster.
SPAWNS(MonsterType): if foe misses you rolling 1-5, spawn MonsterType.
SUS(MonsterType): unless any SEEING foe, 1st time any foe misses you
                                rolling 1-5, turn into MonsterType
SWARM: PUNY, FRAIL and loses VOROUS if HURT
STALKER: has Advantage attacking MENTAL foes
STILLER: bound foes lose blaster, can't use daily powers or inflict MENTAL.
THICK: Can't be HURT by PUNY hits, unless attack roll is 15+
THIEF: On hit steals d20 gp item or gp. If 2 HURT, gains ESCAPER.
TIMID: Non-PURSUER. if you miss it, it moves to adjacent tile, exploring it.
TIMED: loses CALM and gains PURSUER, if anyone at any tile rolls 1-3, 


TOXIC: inflicts ILL on hit.
TERRORIST: can't be hit while any foe is BOUND
TRAPPER: foe on tile without 10XP or SEEING gains BOUND.
UMBRAL: front-row foes (and unprotected back-row) lose FIRE.
UNDEAD: Instead of PUNY hit gain TIRED.
               Immune to AGED and ILL.
VAMPIRIC: loses HURT if it hits non- contruct/undead/elemental
VALUED: killing it gives 2 INFAMY, if it has alive ally on tile.
VENOMOUS: ILL foes gain HURT when attack and miss any target.
VULNERABLE: INFORMED actor can do task to kill it
VOROUS: 1 BOUND foes gains HURT each time this monster activates.
WARDER: mental foes disappear, but do task to reappear and lose mental
WARD_EVIL/GOOD: actors of that alignment are PUNY and GAWKY.
WARPER: Can attack protected backrow foe. AI prefers HURT and FRAIL.
                 Ignores ELEVATED/FLOODED/CHASM on exits.
WEAKENER: ILL foes are PUNY and FRAIL while on your tile.

BOUND: Can't protect backrow allies. Foe gains +1 XP on each miss to it.
                Ends on Camping, or by doing HARD Athletics task.
                If INFORMED foe defeats you and there is no captive ally,
                then lose COMA and 2 HURT, and gain CAPTIVE.
 Note: If all allies are defeated, CAPTIVE heroes can escape through
            Prison Escape rules.
ILL: if TOUGH, ends on Camping. Undead/Gizmo are immune to ILL.
MENTAL: Can't gain FOCUS.

Note: MENTAL/BOUND/ILL - vulnerability markers. To inflict them, actor's TIRED must not be above HURT and actor gains TIRED. 
MENTAL's charmer/hunter/stalker/etc.. affect allies, not foes.
FIRE/WATER/RADIANT/ELDRICH/ACID - hit types.
FIRE hit makes target lose WATER. WATER hit - lose FIRE.


Interpret vague rules in a way benefiting monsters. 
D6 CITY TASK
                            Given N explored tiles, roll d6 + N. At night, add 4.
     1-4. Open Lane  (no task - the way is clear)
  5. Misdirection cr1 frail hiding investigation/insight
6. Shopping Street cr1 greedy frail growing blocker persuasion/insight
7. Slums cr2 tough sicker trapper weakener survival/medicine/insight
8. Toll Gate cr2 greedy tough indomitable persuasion/intimidation
9. Toxic Spill cr2 tough hazard caustic scavenger investigation/sleight
10. Closing Passage cr3 frail blocker chiller growing acrobatics/athletics
11. Quarantine Line cr3 tough foul scary medicine/deception/sleight
12. Haunted Passage cr3 frail dread scary religion/performance
13. Street Scuffle cr3 tough growing retributor intimidation/performance
14. Hidden Passage cr3 agile mirrored phased investigation/survival
15. Animal Herd cr4 tough indomitable healing acrobatics/athletics/taming
16. Maze cr4 tough hiding mirrored survival/investigation
17. Procession cr4 greedy army deception/insight/sleight
18. Collapse cr5 epic thick hard hazard athletics/acrobatics
19. Conflagration cr5 epic mire chiller hazard survival/acrobatics
20+. Unrest cr6 indomitable retributor growing army
            intimidation/persuasion/performance

 16 |  3  4  4  5  6  6  7   8   9  23 | 3 E  | evil

 19 |  3  4  5  6  7  8  9  10  11  27 | 3 W  | lawful evil
 20 |  3  4  5  6  7  8  9  10  12  30 | 3 NW | lawful evil
DIR - direction, usually relative to the current world map area.
4SW means move 4 areas into south-west direction. If out of bounds, reroll.
D8 WAY:  1. N,   2. NE,   3. E,   4. SE,  5. S,   6. SW,   7. W,   8. NW.
D20 CITY: Assign each city a number. Do D20 Map to pick one.
DIRSHIFT: 2x D20 Map/Dir from current Area, linking but not exploring areas.
D20 AREA: DirShift from a D20 City (no city? - current area).
